records.name: AppTraction
records.tagline: Supercharge Apple App Store analytics
records.description: AppTraction is a native Mac app that makes App Store Connect make sense. Your sales, analytics, ratings, and reviews live on your Mac and appear instantly. It monitors your apps, flags problems, trends, and milestones, and writes weekly, monthly, and annual reports. Its AI evaluates your listing and helps fix it, and you can chat about any chart or report. It’s primed with Apple’s own ASO advice and uses your existing Claude or Codex subscription. Your data is stored only on your Mac.

records.name: Daytwo
records.tagline: Let your team change your custom site without touching code
records.description: Ask for a new landing page, a pricing plan or a signup form, and Daytwo builds it on your Next.js or Astro site from your own brand and components. It waits in a private draft until someone on your team approves it. Publishing is a normal commit to your GitHub repo, your developers keep working as usual, and it runs on your own Claude plan. Stop using Daytwo and your site keeps running exactly as it is.

records.name: TOWeb 15
records.tagline: Rewritten as a native Mac & Windows app, with AI and MCP
records.description: TOWeb 15 is a complete rewrite of our 20-year-old desktop website builder. It is now a native app for Mac (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows that builds fast, accessible websites and online stores without code. New: write directly on the page, 50 complete styles in light and dark, a built-in AI assistant (local or cloud), and in the Studio edition your own AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini) can drive TOWeb through MCP. Works offline, publishes to any host, no subscription.

records.name: Gesso
records.tagline: Ask ChatGPT or Claude to design, then edit every layer
records.description: Connect Gesso to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or any agent and ask for a website, a deck or a poster. It builds live on your canvas in real HTML and CSS layers you can drag, restyle and export. Free to try on Mac.

records.name: Alsona
records.tagline: AI agents that turn buying signals into booked sales calls
records.description: 95% of prospects aren't ready to buy when you reach out. Alsona finds the ones showing buying intent right now. It tracks 32+ signals across hiring, funding, tech changes, reviews, ad spend, and more, then scores companies against your ICP and explains why they're worth contacting. AI agents turn those signals into personalized LinkedIn and email outreach, helping you start conversations while the buying window is open. Alsona helps you book calls directly with the 5% who is ready to buy today.

records.name: MoreFrame
records.tagline: Dual-screen recording and editing for Mac and Windows
records.description: Record your screen and a second window, add 500+ motion graphics, captions and Smart Zoom, or let any AI edit over MCP. Free for Mac and Windows, no watermark.

records.name: TK by Medium
records.tagline: An agentic notebook to build your best thinking
records.description: What if every thought had the chance to become something extraordinary? Meet TK, the agentic notebook by Medium. Capture every spark, from shower thoughts to forgotten notes. With AI right where you write, connect the dots, surface new possibilities, and compound what you know without breaking your flow. Then turn your thinking into writing that’s unmistakably yours. With built-in community and an MCP server that connects to your favorite LLMs and AI tools.

records.name: Latch.ai
records.tagline: Automate complex accounting work without a single prompt
records.description: Latch is built for accountants buried in click-heavy close work. Instead of writing prompts, you do a task on screen and talk it through, including the parts no SOP captures: the three-day matching window, the rate you always override. Latch asks about the exceptions, then builds a sidekick that runs the task the same way every time, right in the tools you already use. When something doesn't fit, it stops and asks you. Every step is logged for review.

records.name: AppuBot
records.tagline: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free
records.description: AI teammates you hand real work to. They use the apps on your Mac or PC like you do, while you watch or take over, and come back with it done. Runs on the AI plan you already have, so the app is free. AppuBot Cloud keeps them working 24/7 from $19/mo.

records.name: Nadhif
records.tagline: Check Mac, server and website security
records.description: Check Mac security settings, audit Debian/Ubuntu servers over read-only SSH, and inspect websites you own after DNS verification. Then clear developer clutter and use the free cleaner with 7-day restore for most items. Developer and Security tools: about $33 for a lifetime license, no subscription, 7-day trial. macOS 15+, Apple silicon, ~12 MB.

records.name: Seldon
records.tagline: Behavioral QA agents that use your product like customers do
records.description: Find the tests you didn’t know to write. Tell Wren what should work in plain English. Its QA agents try the paths your customers take, like going back to change an address halfway through checkout or retrying a failed payment. When something breaks, you get a replay and the steps to reproduce the bug. First 10 runs free.

records.name: ZUS
records.tagline: AI-native IDE: agents code with human review
records.description: ZUS is a desktop IDE with an AI agent built in. The agent reads your codebase, plans, edits and runs commands within the permissions you grant. You read every diff before keeping it, undo what it got wrong, and see each subagent's tool calls in Team Inspector. Your project index and context stay on your machine, and you connect your own AI provider. Built on Tauri 2 and Rust, with a ~20 MB Windows installer. Runs on Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon) and Linux.

records.name: gitmanual
records.tagline: See if a GitHub repo runs on your OS, and how to set it up
records.description: Know if a GitHub project will run on your computer before you clone it. Paste any repo link and get its setup manual: a yes/no verdict for macOS, Windows or Linux, everything you need to install, and the exact steps, or one setup script. It reads the repo's own files, no AI guessing, and links to the maintainers' guide when unsure. Swap "hub" for "manual" in any GitHub URL, use the Chrome extension, or the MCP server for AI assistants. Works on private repos. Free and open source.

records.name: ChromePing
records.tagline: Talk to anyone by phone, in a language you don't speak
records.description: Move somewhere you don't speak the language and the phone becomes a wall — the immigration office, your bank, a landlord, a clinic, even ordering food. The usual fix is bringing a human translator, if you can find one. ChromePing lets you call any real phone number — mobile or landline, anywhere — from your browser. No app to install, yours or theirs. The call is translated live, both ways, with captions. Whoever you call just answers their normal phone. Pay as you go, no subscription.

records.name: Operum
records.tagline: Your AI product team, with expert workflows built in
records.description: Build and launch software without managing AI agents. The Operum desktop app gives founders and developers a coordinated AI product team: PM, Architect, Engineer, Tester, Marketing, Community. Describe your goal in chat; agents plan, build in your GitHub repo, independently test changes, and help you launch. Expert workflows and human approvals are built in, with optional auto-merge. Use Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex. Engines change; your team stays. Free plan + 14-day Premium trial. No card.

records.name: OpenVibe
records.tagline: A canvas of real terminals for your AI coding agents
records.description: Desktop app that runs your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Aider and more) in real terminals on an infinite canvas. Group them into teams, brief a team in one line, review their changes, and hand a big task to an orchestrator. Windows, MIT.

records.name: Kata Send
records.tagline: Cold email infrastructure for AI agents
records.description: Kata Send lets your AI agent run cold email. One command from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor: Kata checks the addresses, writes the emails, sends from warmed inboxes and follows up in the same thread. It reads replies, clicks and sales, then sends more of the version that sells. Daily caps and auto pause protect deliverability. Start with no domains at $0.04 per email, or connect your own inboxes from $29 a month. $10 free to start.

records.name: Tokens by UI Colors
records.tagline: Build your product’s visual language with design tokens
records.description: Tokens is a visual playground for creating a unique visual language for your digital product. Explore colors, typography, spacing, radius, and shadows with simple controls, then fine-tune every detail with advanced customization options. Tokens uses a reusable system of primitive and semantic design tokens to help keep your interfaces consistent across websites, SaaS products, and apps, whether built by humans or AI agents. Export it as CSS variables or a DESIGN.md file.

records.name: Billing MCP By SubscriptionFlow
records.tagline: Open Source AI Agent to Run Your Subscription Billing
records.description: Monetize your AI apps and assistants down to the single action, using Stripe, PayPal, Authorize.net and other major payment gateways. With the SubscriptionFlow MCP billing plugin, bill customers per question answered, task completed, or custom action. Offer prepaid credit wallets or post-billing with real-time balance checks that eliminate overspending. Set dynamic usage rates, automate metering, and protect margins, turning AI consumption into automated revenue.

records.name: Opal Reader
records.tagline: Read PDFs and EPUBs on iPhone Duo
records.description: Opal Reader is a PDF and EPUB reader with a notebook beside the page. On iPhone Duo, unfold to read your book and your notes together, then fold it closed and keep reading in a compact view with your place saved. Also available on iPhone and iPad.

records.name: Lottie AI
records.tagline: Editable vector animations from a text prompt
records.description: Motion generated as editable vector animation, built with builders in mind. Get a lightweight Lottie you can recolor, restyle and resize without regenerating, with custom controls for every animation. Add hover and click interactions with a simple prompt. Start with Turbo for quick ideas, or switch to Quality when you have a solid plan. No motion-design skills needed. Export to dotLottie, JSON, GIF, video and more.

records.name: Wipecraft
records.tagline: Mac System Data cleaner with on-device AI mode
records.description: macOS shows System Data as one number. Wipecraft lists what is in it, and in the rest of the disk, with each item's size and what removing it does. It knows what Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Xcode, simulators and Docker leave behind, and locks work in progress. Ask Overview a question with AI mode, which runs on your Mac. Safe cleanup can run on a schedule. Nothing comes selected; what does not rebuild itself goes to Quarantine for 30 days. Scanning is free; cleaning is a one-time license.

records.name: Maxma
records.tagline: The 24/7 AI teammate that scales your paid ad performance
records.description: Maxma is the AI platform that 10Xs your human marketers. It does the end-to-end work of paid advertising, from analyzing performance, creating ads and landing pages, and launching and optimizing campaigns across channels, to managing tracking and reporting. Working like a teammate in Slack, on demand or proactively 24/7, it proposes changes for approval and drives measurable, incremental growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, ChatGPT Ads, and more. So lean teams can grow without limits.

records.name: ForAgent
records.tagline: Private phone numbers so AI agents can call each other
records.description: ForAgent gives your AI agents private phone numbers so they can talk to each other, on your own computers or with other people. Handle calls in our app, or right inside your AI with the plugin. You choose who gets through.

records.name: Coffee
records.tagline: A quiet Markdown editor for Mac, with sums in your notes
records.description: Coffee is a native Mac Markdown editor. Your notes stay plain Markdown files in a folder you choose. Answers to sums appear beside the line, maths and Mermaid diagrams are drawn natively, and you review every change an AI tool makes to a note. 14 days free.

records.name: RunThru
records.tagline: Video proof that your agent's pull request works
records.description: Comment /runthru on a pull request. An agent uses the feature on your preview, films a narrated walkthrough, and a second model grades whether it works. Video and verdict land in the PR in 5 minutes, with a share link and a Slack post. Free: 5 videos a month.

records.name: SideKick By Open
records.tagline: “Claude, but for your product” is here.
records.description: Make your product agentic in one click. Sidekick puts an AI agent inside your own product. Customers say what they need in one sentence and Sidekick does the work, long-horizon tasks, reports, actions, even navigating the UI for them. It's MCP-compatible, so it connects to the tools they already use. Sidekick is connected to the main Open platform, a full-stack customer communications engine: the same engine behind AI customer support and Open for Sales, now inside your product.

records.name: Obsiva
records.tagline: Turn site pics + voice notes into a PDF inspection report
records.description: Obsiva turns site photos and voice notes into a professional PDF inspection report, on your phone, before you leave the site. Snap photos, mark the issue, talk. AI writes each finding (description, severity, responsible party, action) and the executive summary. On the next visit, track what's still open with before/after photos. Works offline. Bilingual reports (English/Spanish). Free on Android; Pro adds unlimited reports, cloud backup and your logo.

records.name: FigSchema
records.tagline: Design database schemas right in FigJam
records.description: FigSchema turns FigJam into a database schema designer. Table cards with typed columns and PK/FK badges, relationships anchored to columns that follow every move, and export to SQL, DBML or docs. Paste CREATE TABLE statements and the diagram builds itself.

records.name: Clive
records.tagline: Let Claude and other AIs set your iPhone alarms
records.description: A lot of us run our lives with alarms, but setting them one at a time is a hassle. With Clive, you can ask Claude to set them for you, even from your calendar, through Apple's AlarmKit. In the app, Clive walks to the right instrument and plays it.

records.name: LotusQ
records.tagline: Talk instead of type, in any app
records.description: LotusQ is now on iPhone. Add the keyboard, tap Start and talk: your words are typed into any app, in 78 languages, or translated as you speak. 7 days of everything, then Free: 2,000 words a week. Also on Mac, Windows and Linux.

records.name: Ownkube
records.tagline: Deploy apps from your coding agent with one prompt
records.description: Paste one line into Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, and your agent deploys the repo on Ownkube: the app, a managed Postgres and a cache, live on HTTPS. You sign in and approve the deploy. Apps bill per minute for what they use, so an idle app costs almost nothing. Credit you top up never expires. Bring your own cloud: when a customer wants your app in their own AWS account, you deploy the same app there with no rewrite, logs and metrics included.

records.name: Dover Startup Jobs
records.tagline: Where great startups meet great candidates
records.description: Dover Startup Jobs helps venture-backed startups attract great candidates for free. Reach people who want to work at startups, post jobs in any region, publish in one click, and manage every applicant in one place.

records.name: CollaboTokyo
records.tagline: Explore a virtual Tokyo to network, market, and collaborate
records.description: What if networking felt more like exploring a city than scrolling through a feed? CollaboTokyo is a virtual Tokyo where creators, builders, entrepreneurs, and brands from around the world meet, discover projects, and collaborate. The city is broken up into districts & neighborhoods each with its own category/topic so you can explore and share project, work, and ideas with people in the same niche. Explore the city. Meet people. Make things happen.

records.name: CloakPane
records.tagline: A Mac browser that stays out of your screen shares
records.description: CloakPane is a private Mac browser hidden from screenshots, screen recordings and screen sharing. Keep your bank or password manager open on a call; the others see only what's behind the window. Free to use as a browser, Pro from $2.99 a month.

records.name: MuJoCo 4
records.tagline: A physics engine for robots with its own studio
records.description: MuJoCo 4 is a major update to Google DeepMind's open-source physics engine. It adds a modular 3D Studio, improved deformable-body simulation, and better handling of fast collisions. Explore models in your browser or build custom viewers.

records.name: Quillo
records.tagline: Listen to any PDF in a natural voice, then ask Quillo Ai
records.description: Quillo reads PDFs, Word files, photos and web pages aloud in a natural voice and highlights each sentence. Quillo Ai answers questions about your documents. Merge, compress, sign, scan and convert for free on Android, iPhone and the web.

records.name: Ember
records.tagline: Free, open-source Slack you host on Cloudflare in one click
records.description: Open Source Slack and Campfire inspired chat with one click deploy to Cloudflare. Slack-compatible payloads, AI assistant, media attachments, all built-in and hosted for $0 on Cloudflare free tiers.

records.name: Rodeo
records.tagline: A Notion alternative with AI meeting notes on the free plan
records.description: Rodeo is a workspace for docs, wikis and databases your team edits together in real time. AI meeting notes come with every plan, including Free: transcript, summary, decisions and tasks. Plus Ask AI, an AI canvas and a built-in MCP server. Imports Notion.

records.name: QuotedPart
records.tagline: AI quoting for CNC and sheet metal job shops
records.description: QuotedPart reads the quote request and its files, then prices every quantity on your own machines and rates in under a minute. An estimator checks it and sends the quote. $399/mo per shop, first 20 shops $199.

records.name: Levo
records.tagline: Your AI agent finds what's safe to delete on your Mac
records.description: Levo lives in your menubar and watches disk, memory, CPU and GPU. When space runs low, your own AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any CLI) checks what's filling your Mac, even System Data. You tick what goes, and Levo cleans it up.

records.name: Kumiko
records.tagline: AI window manager for ultrawide and big-screen Macs
records.description: Kumiko is an AI powered Mac window manager for ultrawide and big monitors. Snap windows with ⌃⌥ and the arrow keys, pick one of six layouts that fit your screen, or just say what you are working on and Kumiko arranges every window.

records.name: Inspo by Context.dev
records.tagline: Real website inspiration for your coding agent
records.description: Describe the website you want to build, find real design references, and turn your picks into a prompt for your coding agent. Use Inspo in your browser or add it to your agent through MCP. Free, with no API key needed.

records.name: VeilCC
records.tagline: Ship code AI can't reverse engineer
records.description: Ship code AI can't reverse-engineer. VeilCC hardens it with AI-resistant obfuscation and seals your key logic, so attackers can't crack, clone, or cheat your game or app.

records.name: openring
records.tagline: Open-source voice AI agents with no platform fee
records.description: Self-hosted voice AI agents with a Vapi-compatible API. AI phone agents on Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Vonage or SIP, with your keys or 100% local and free (Whisper, Ollama, Kokoro). No per-minute platf...

records.name: Kettle
records.tagline: The helper in your family group chat
records.description: Kettle is a helper in your family's group chat. There's no app and nothing to set up: text it on its own, or start a group message with "Kettle." It remembers the details you tell it, plans dinners around your week, builds a grocery cart for you to review and check out, and sends group or private reminders plus a short morning brief. Getting started: text hi, each person texts once so it knows who's who, then add Kettle to the group. 7 days free, then $19 a month for the whole family.

records.name: Co-Review
records.tagline: Read the whole repository with the agent that built it
records.description: Agent-built code works but stops feeling like yours. Co-Review opens the whole repository as a review: comment on a line, file or folder, ask why, and the agent answers from the code. Also reviews diffs, PRs and designs. Free, open source, no telemetry.

records.name: Willder
records.tagline: The context layer that syncs your apps, agents and teams
records.description: A context layer that syncs your apps, agents and teams. Each agent gets its own scoped, revocable token; what one agent writes, the others read on their next call; connectors bring your apps in under the same rules (measured on GitHub so far). The engine is MIT and self-hostable.

records.name: Almanzor
records.tagline: Ask AI + MCP server for your docs, with cited answers
records.description: Paste your docs URL and get an assistant that answers from your pages, cites its source and says when it doesn't know. Add it with one script tag, share a link, or let coding agents search your docs through a hosted MCP server.

records.name: HitPay Agentic Discovery
records.tagline: Make your store findable and buyable by AI agents
records.description: Agentic Discovery lets any AI assistant find and recommend what you sell on HitPay: product and price and a Checkout with HitPay button in chat. Each store gets its own MCP server. Free to switch on; standard fees when you sell.

records.name: Rowflare
records.tagline: Open-source Airtable alternative on Cloudflare
records.description: Open-source (AGPL-3.0) Airtable alternative that runs on your own Cloudflare account: $5/month for the whole team instead of $20 per seat.

records.name: Flash USDT Guide
records.tagline: Flash USDT Is Not Real: Check TRC20 and ERC20 USDT
records.description: Independent guides showing why flash USDT is a scam, how to check any USDT transfer, and where to report sellers. https://flashusdtguide.com/

records.name: Null’s Brawl
records.tagline: nulls brawl download, online game, Brawl Stars
records.description: Download Null's Brawl v70.648 APK, a Brawl Stars private server with unlimited gems, gold and boxes. Play with friends on any brawler you want.

records.tagline: Cold email infrastructure for AI agents

records.name: Finmarket Pro Native Engine
records.tagline: Native algorithmic charting engine with live backtest stats.

Instead of relying on heavy third-party iframes, it calculates real-time BUY/SELL momentum signals directly in the browser across 5M to 1W timeframes. Every chart includes a live Statistical Analytics matrix displaying Total Signals, Win Rate, Profit Factor, and Max Drawdown to help traders evaluate quantitative strategies without emotional bias.

records.name: AlliedRooms
records.tagline: Online directory for allied health room rentals in Melbourne
records.description: AlliedRooms connects Melbourne practice owners with visiting allied health, psychology, and medical clinicians looking for flexible sessional room rentals. Practice managers can list unused consulting suites for free without lock-in contracts or middleman booking commissions. Visiting practitioners browse available therapy rooms across key Melbourne health precincts and connect directly with host clinics.

records.tagline: content creators from all genres

records.description: A starter kit for anyone who wants to try a small online side hustle without overthinking it. It includes AI prompt formulas, a Business Idea Generator, prompts for content, products, and social posts, a Simple Income Tracker (PDF + CSV), and a 4-week plan to follow step by step. Made by a solo creator in Spokane, WA. No income promises — just a practical starting point. Launch-week offer: 25% off with code LAUNCH25 through Sunday, Nov 15.

records.name: Prompset
records.tagline: Turn any image or video into a prompt for your AI model
records.description: Upload an image or a short video and Prompset writes a prompt for the AI model you'll use: Nano Banana, GPT Image, Midjourney, Seedance, Kling, Veo and more. Each prompt follows that model's official guide, so Midjourney gets --ar and Nano Banana gets plain sentences. Free: 5 images a day without an account, 10 with one, and 1 video a day. Your files aren't kept. Plus a free library of 38,000+ real prompts, each shown with the image or video it made.

records.name: Glitchfall
records.tagline: Match-3 puzzle where gravity changes after every move
records.description: Swap tiles to make lines of 3, but gravity shifts after each move and glitches scramble the board. 200+ levels, a daily level with a leaderboard, no ads, no subscription, fully offline.

records.name: Gramm: Protein Tracker
records.tagline: AI Protein & Meal Tracker
records.description: Gramm makes protein tracking effortless with AI. Just take a photo of your meal — Gramm's AI instantly analyzes it and estimates the protein, calories, carbs, fat, and more. No manual searching through food databases, no tedious logging. Whether you're building muscle, cutting weight, or just trying to hit your protein goals consistently, Gramm removes the friction from tracking so you can focus on your results. Gramm offers a 3-day free trial.

records.name: BandNine
records.tagline: IELTS Speaking practice with an AI examiner
records.description: BandNine runs the IELTS Speaking test out loud. Alex, an AI examiner for practice, takes you through Part 1, the Part 2 task card (one minute to prepare, two to speak) and the Part 3 discussion. Afterwards you get estimated bands for the four criteria, and each correction quotes your own words. Pick one, say the answer again and compare. New accounts start with 17 credits, enough for one full mock test. AI practice estimate. Not an official IELTS result.

records.name: Kendor
records.tagline: AI-allowed coding interviews in a real dev environment
records.description: Coding interviews where candidates can use AI, and you see exactly how they did it. • Start from your own repo: paste a job description and Claude drafts the task • A real project sandbox: editor, terminal, database, live preview • Candidates use their own agent: Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor, Copilot and more • Replay every prompt, edit and test run, plus an AI summary • Run their code and tests yourself Screens, live interviews and hackathons. EU hosted.

records.name: Mosaik
records.tagline: A calm habit tracker where your habits paint a picture
records.description: Mosaik is a calm habit tracker for iPhone where your habits paint a picture. Every day you show up adds a piece of sea glass to a 66-day canvas that slowly reveals a hidden picture. A missed day is a quieter piece, never a reset. It follows the sun: sky by day, deep blue with the moon at night. Breaks and easy days, goals, Apple Health auto-tracking, widgets and an Apple Watch app. Free for 3 habits, no account needed. iPhone only for now; Android is coming soon.

records.name: Swayanta
records.tagline: Your birthday, turned into a journey through real space
records.description: Enter your birthday and Swayanta takes you through real space, in 3D, built from astronomers' star and galaxy catalogues. It begins with the sky as it truly was the night you were born, then carries you past the Milky Way to the edge of the universe, with you at its centre. The 43,375 galaxies stand where they have been mapped, and the images come from NASA, ESA and ESO. Try it yourself, or make one for someone you love. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: Coachingo
records.tagline: All in one sports coaching platform for individual coaches
records.description: Organize lessons, player records, player notes and messages with Coachingo. Coaches set their own lesson prices, with a path for players and parents to find coaching. Coaches setup their profile and se a link to the students which they can use to directly book the coach, coach has drills, his whole schedule in a calendar view online payments and clinics everything a sports coach is going to need ever.

records.name: Order Reconcile
records.tagline: Compare Shopify & ShipStation CSV quantities offline
records.description: Spot order and SKU quantity differences between Shopify Orders and ShipStation Shipment Line Items CSV exports. Order Reconcile runs locally in your browser, groups quantities by order and SKU, and flags mismatches for manual review. Export your findings as a CSV report without uploading order data. One-time purchase: ¥2,980. Free fictional samples and a walkthrough are available. No live integrations or delivery verification.

records.name: Arthur VR · Real-scale mode
records.tagline: Walk inside your 3D models in VR, straight from the browser
records.description: Arthur, the multilingual AI agent with a 3D hologram, now works in VR on Meta Quest — no app. Ask for any 3D model by voice, grab it with your hands, and step inside at real scale for architectural walkthroughs, open spaces and game worlds.

records.name: Miner: Video & Music Player
records.tagline: Stream NAS videos and music across your Apple devices
records.description: Miner turns your NAS into a personal media library on iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, and Mac. Stream videos and music directly from SMB or WebDAV without setting up a media server or transcoding. Enjoy hardware-accelerated playback, embedded and external subtitles, playlists, and resume points. Mac also supports local folders. Start with 10 free plays every day; Pro unlocks unlimited playback with monthly, yearly, or lifetime plans. Bring your own media.

records.name: DSA Doctor
records.tagline: What to solve + how to think: DSA prep by company
records.description: Master company-wise DSA questions, 30-day recency filters, 8 core interview patterns, and the 7-step logic building framework for top tech product roles.

records.name: Assindo
records.tagline: The AI that answers your phone, and makes your calls
records.description: Assindo is an AI phone assistant. It answers your calls, screens spam and unknown numbers, and turns what callers say into summaries and tasks. It also makes calls for you: booking appointments, chasing a refund, sitting through phone menus and hold music. You get your own number and an assistant with a voice. Works on iPhone, Android and the web, and inside Claude as an MCP connector. Built for people who hate the phone and small businesses that miss calls.

records.name: Vikapu
records.tagline: Smarter shopping lists for households and teams.
records.description: Vikapu turns everyday shopping lists into a shared, accountable system: plan what to buy, track what you actually spend, and turn purchase lists into clean, exportable records. It’s local-first, works offline, and scales from one family to a full procurement team.

records.name: Memora+
records.tagline: Turn buried iPhone photos into editable memory movies
records.description: Your best moments are buried under thousands of photos. Memora+ is a local-first smart gallery for iPhone and iPad that finds family, travel, pets and anniversaries in your library and turns them into memory movies — no editing skills needed. Every story starts as an editable draft: swap, remove or reorder photos, pick 15/30/60s or custom length, music, mood and transitions before rendering. Analysis is on-device by default; cloud AI is opt-in only.

records.name: Legacyfolio – Emergency Folder
records.tagline: The emergency folder your family will thank you for
records.description: Legacyfolio is your digital emergency and estate planning folder. Everything your loved ones need to know when it matters, in one place – encrypted, with no account and no subscription. Who knows where your power of attorney is kept? Which accounts and insurance policies you have? Who to call first? Legacyfolio guides you step by step through everything that matters and shows you what is still missing.

records.name: TypeCrux
records.tagline: Chrome text expander that keeps snippets 100 percent private
records.description: Most text expanders sync everything you type to their cloud. TypeCrux does the opposite: your snippet library lives in your browser's storage, on your device. No account, no sign-up, no servers, no tracking — it even works fully offline. Type a shortcut, pick your delimiter, and your full text appears — emails, replies, forms, code, anything you write twice. Folders, data tables, export/import, 16 languages. Free: 25 snippets, 5 tables. Pro: unlimited — $2.99/month, $29/year or $59 lifetime.

records.name: Napzilla
records.tagline: The app that reminds you to do absolutely nothing
records.description: Napzilla is a dummy product made for testing. It has no real features and does nothing useful. It exists only so you can practice setting up a Product Hunt page.

records.name: Twig
records.tagline: Break any idea into branching cards, and see your next step
records.description: Twig organizes thoughts, projects and tasks as branching cards. Break an idea into child cards and see every branch's next step and progress, as an outline, canvas, board or grid. Free, works in any browser and offline, no account needed.

records.name: ZenBurst
records.tagline: ZenBurst: AI Chief of Staff for Workplace Energy
records.description: ZenBurst is an AI-powered wellbeing assistant built into Slack that helps teams build healthier work habits through focus sessions, timely breaks, and engaging activities. Its privacy-first approach uses activity signals rather than reading private messages, making it easier for employees to stay focused, recharge, and work sustainably.

records.name: DocPipelineAI
records.tagline: ATS resume scoring + balance-verified statement extraction.
records.description: Two document jobs, one pipeline: • ATS resume check — paste or upload a resume, name the role, get a 0-100 score across five weighted dimensions, your missing keywords, and line-level rewrite suggestions. • Bank statement extraction — batch up to 20 PDFs or scans into one ledger. Every line is reconciled against the running balance; breaks get flagged, not silently exported. CSV/XLSX/JSON. First run free, no account. Files deleted after processing.

records.name: The Twistor's Engineer
records.tagline: Engineering rules your coding agent can cite
records.description: 11 Agent Skills that give your coding agent sourced engineering advice. Each rule is "instead of X, do Y" and links to the public post it came from. Covers agents, evals, system design, incidents, performance, data and ML, AI-assisted coding, security and frontend/mobile, plus a diff reviewer and a postmortem writer. Works in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and OpenCode. In our own test of 18 questions it scored 97% with the skills and 76% without. Free, MIT.

records.name: Attendance Hub
records.tagline: Simple attendance and member management for communities
records.description: Attendance Hub helps associations, foundations, and communities manage their members and weekly attendance in one place. Track attendance, record absence excuses, view attendance history, monitor repeated absences, organize volunteer duties, and share events and announcements.

records.name: Tradero
records.tagline: Two-Way Offer (2WO) platform for B2B buying and selling
records.description: B2B buying and selling often gets scattered across WhatsApp, emails, PDFs, and spreadsheets, making quotations, comparisons, and orders difficult to manage. Tradero is a Two-Way Offer (2WO) platform built for wholesalers, suppliers, distributors, buyers, and B2B sales teams. Buyers create Buy Requests (BRO), sellers share Sell Offers (SRO), and trading partners respond through shared links without signing up. Compare quotations, review prices and terms, and turn selected responses into orders.

records.name: DAR POS Pro
records.tagline: RESTAURANT POINT OF SALE
records.description: DAR POS Pro is a web and mobile point-of-sale platform designed specifically for restaurants and cafes. It streamlines table ordering, inventory tracking, bill management, and daily sales reporting with a fast, intuitive interface that works seamlessly on both browser and mobile devices.

records.name: MyTinyDeskAI
records.tagline: Turn one photo into a Tiny Desk concert video
records.description: MyTinyDeskAI turns one portrait into a short concert video. Pick from six prepared scenes - a five-piece desk band, solo, duet or a cat lead - upload the photos each scene asks for, and the studio renders a 15- or 19-second vertical MP4 with sound. Every scene is a fixed template, so the room, camera and band stay consistent. 720p is $9.90, 1080p $19.80, one-time credits, no subscription.

records.name: Guide Workspace — Beta
records.tagline: Turn clicks into step-by-step guides Free, private, no-cloud
records.description: Guide Workspace records what you do in Chrome and turns it into a step-by-step how-to guide. Free, no account, and your captures never leave your device. Full exports are free. Public beta: practice data only, not live customer data.

records.name: OxelLab Assistant
records.tagline: AI Phone Receptionist for Small Business
records.description: AI phone receptionist for small US businesses. Answers calls 24/7 in the caller's language, books to Google Calendar, writes up every call, quotes prices, and places outbound calls.

records.name: Compendium
records.tagline: Read along with 1,100+ classic audiobooks
records.description: Follow every sentence of the great books. Compendium has 1,100+ classic audiobooks, from Plato and Marcus Aurelius to Austen and Dostoevsky, with the text on screen and the sentence being read highlighted. The first chapter of every book is free with no account, and a free account keeps one full book. iPhone, iPad, Android and the web.

records.name: SEOMEG
records.tagline: Free Tag Generator for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, bloggers
records.description: SEOMEG.com is a lightweight online SEO tools platform built for bloggers, YouTubers, content creators, digital marketers and website owners. The project was developed using Blogger with a custom XML theme, HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Most tools operate directly in the user's browser without requiring external APIs, databases, user accounts or expensive server infrastructure. Cloudflare is used for domain and DNS management.

records.name: LotNook
records.tagline: Simple management for small RV parks and campgrounds
records.description: LotNook is simple management software for small RV parks and campgrounds. Set up your park and spaces, then run the whole park in one place: see occupied, vacant, and past-due spaces at a glance, track rent per space, generate monthly billing, message tenants, log maintenance, and keep leases and notices in one vault. Built for owner-operators with long-term monthly tenants — not for nightly tourist bookings, and not for 400-site resorts. Made for the little parks.

records.name: Agilestsol Toolbox
records.tagline: 27 free browser tools for everyday tasks
records.description: Agilestsol Toolbox brings 27 free tools into one simple website. Resize and compress images, convert file formats, merge and manage PDFs, clean up text, format JSON, encode URLs, generate QR codes, and handle everyday calculations. No account or installation is needed. Your selected files and text are processed in your browser, not sent to Agilestsol's servers.

records.name: Dress Code Decoder
records.tagline: Decode any dress code into an outfit that works
records.description: The invitation says black tie optional, cocktail, or smart casual, and you are standing in front of your closet guessing. Pick the dress code and get the plain English answer in seconds: what it means, what to wear, what to skip, and the shoes and bag that finish the look. All 7 dress codes on one formality scale. Free, instant, no signup.

records.name: claudeskills.page
records.tagline: 504 free, expert-written skills for Claude Code
records.description: claudeskills.page is a library of 504 installable SKILL.md playbooks for Claude Code, across 25 categories from Postgres and React to firmware, game engines and product planning. - Each skill gives Claude a senior practitioner's workflow, real commands, known pitfalls and a way to verify the result - Skills load only when the task calls for them - Install any skill with one command, or download them all - Free, with 24 Pro skills from $4.99

records.name: DeskPile
records.tagline: Bring a whole group of Mac windows back with one key
records.description: Group the windows you use together (VS Code + Chrome + Terminal, Slack + Mail) and press one shortcut: the whole group comes to the front, tiled by layout and framed in its colour. The same window can sit in several groups. Works with Spaces and multiple displays. Native Swift, ~3 MB, no account, no telemetry. Free for 2 groups; $15 one-time unlocks 9 groups, unlimited windows and custom shortcuts.

records.name: OTDMath
records.tagline: See what a car really costs out the door, by US state
records.description: A car's sticker price is never what you pay. This calculator itemizes the out-the-door price in all 50 US states: sales or use tax by county, trade-in rules, title, registration and doc fees, each line linked to its official source. Free, no sign-up, runs in your browser.

records.name: ADL Phone Sync
records.tagline: Archive phone photos to Windows with verified copies
records.description: Archive accessible phone photos and videos in organized Windows folders, with verified copies. Android supports cleanup; iPhone/iPad import keeps originals. 7 days free, then US$4.99/month. Non-Samsung Android and Apple hardware testing is pending.

records.name: Zhunly: friends, posts & chat
records.tagline: Nearby strangers with the same need — posts on a map (~200m)
records.description: Zhunly helps people nearby find each other via posts on a map (~200m). Neighbors can like, comment, and chat in the post — walks, hobbies, favors, meetups. Translation for travelers; optional friends map & SOS. Search “Zhunly” on Google Play & App Store. 16+.

records.name: ROVE
records.tagline: Snow forecasts for 640+ North American ski resorts
records.description: ROVE is a free snow and trip tool for skiers in North America. See 15-day snowfall forecasts for 640+ resorts, how accurate past forecasts were, lift and trail status, and road conditions in one place.

records.name: Reel
records.tagline: AI that clicks through your product and builds the demo
records.description: Reel turns how your software works into demos people can watch or click through, shared with one link. Type what to show, like "Show how to set up SSO in Admin", and Reel clicks through your product, captures each step and writes the tooltips. Make click-through demos, clips with voice and camera, or hybrids where viewers pick Watch or Click through. Customer data is blurred before upload. Free for one maker. Pro from $19 per maker a month billed yearly, or $24 monthly.

records.name: Yuktisa Fit
records.tagline: Strength log. No account, no ads. Only on your phone.
records.description: Yuktisa Fit is a local-first strength-training log for iPhone. No sign-up, no account, no ads. Everything you record stays on your phone unless you choose to download it out. Workout log with a 105-exercise library, PRs, streaks, rest timer, cardio, yoga, and meditation. Basic workout logging is free forever. Export any time. Lock the app with Face ID. Also live today from Yuktisa: Yuktisa Journal, a private journal that never leaves your phone either. It gets its own launch here soon.

records.name: NexusNote
records.tagline: Free AI WYSIWYG editor | 200k daily tokens | Typora-ready
records.description: NexusNote is a 100% free, 18MB AI-powered WYSIWYG editor for Markdown, TXT & PDF. Zero login required—enjoy 200,000+ daily free DeepSeek tokens! Seamlessly compatible with Typora and Obsidian, handles long articles, directory batch edits, and exports to social cards, PDFs & Word.

records.name: Soft2Cloud Free Tools
records.tagline: 50 free business calculators and generators, no sign-up
records.description: 50 free online tools for small businesses, shop owners, freelancers and students. Work out GST and sales tax, loan EMI, salary and freelancer tax, property tax, profit margin and zakat; make invoices, quotations, receipts, salary slips and rent agreements as PDF; convert marla and kanal, gold weights and units; create QR codes and barcodes. Everything runs in your browser with no sign-up, and your inputs stay on your device.

records.name: GachaLab
records.tagline: Fast, ad-free gacha game tier lists, guides and codes
records.description: GachaLab is a community-driven database for modern anime gacha games. Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, it offers lightning-fast character tier lists, optimal build calculators, and real-time active redemption codes without intrusive autoplay ads, heavy page scripts, or distracting popups. Updated dynamically per game patch.

records.name: Emoji Battery Icon Status Bar
records.tagline: Customize battery & status bar icons. No root needed.
records.description: A sleek battery icon, a glowing RGB bar, or a cute kitty battery — WITHOUT ROOTING your phone. Pick a shape, paint it your way, and Wi-Fi, signal and clock follow to match. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ This app uses the Android AccessibilityService API. Here is exactly what it is used for, and what it is not. The core feature is drawing your chosen design on top of the system status bar.

records.name: Lemongraph
records.tagline: Task manager for more focused workdays
records.description: Personal task manager for people whose days are split between meetings and their inbox. We turn those conversations into action items before you have even moved on to the next thing. Each morning there is a focused list of what deserves your time today. And those routines you repeat every week? Hand them off once and we will take care of them.

records.name: DetoxApp
records.tagline: A digital detox timer that locks your apps while you're away
records.description: DetoxApp is a calm digital detox timer for iPhone and iPad. Tap Start and Screen Time locks your other apps and websites until you end the session. The screen slowly changes color as your quiet time grows, and a calendar rewards each day: bronze at 4 hours, silver at 8, gold at 12, a crown at 16+. Free with ads, never during a session. Premium adds stats and removes ads. Your records stay on your device, and no account is needed.

records.name: Flyteller
records.tagline: Free flight alerts, delay reasons and your incoming plane
records.description: Flyteller is a free flight and airport app. Follow a flight and get alerts when the gate is announced or changes, or the flight is delayed or cancelled, even with the app closed. See Flyteller’s estimate of when it will leave, with a reason built from that flight’s own facts, and where the plane for your flight is coming from. Add a bag tag and follow your flight to the belt. Boards for 4,081 airports, indoor maps of 280, and a live link for whoever’s collecting you. No account needed.

records.name: PixelArt Cloud
records.tagline: Make pixel art and Pixabots, then share your creations
records.description: Convert images into pixel art with adjustable grids, palettes and dithering, then download PNG or an editablepxa file. Create on the web or use the Figma plugin, Miro app or Add-on for Adobe Express. Explore the community gallery, upload your own creations and make pixel characters with the Pixabots generator. The browser image converter works without signup; accounts support community sharing.

records.name: My Shared Claude
records.tagline: One Claude Code history across all your accounts
records.description: Personal and work Claude accounts? Every switch hides your local Claude Code sessions. My Shared Claude links them into one session list: double-click setup, a preview before anything changes, and one-step undo. Free and open source for Mac, Windows and Linux.

records.name: Mindfuse
records.tagline: Hear the person, not the profile.
records.description: Everybody was once a stranger. Mindfuse puts you on a one-to-one voice call with a real person somewhere else in the world, with one tap. No profile, no photos, no feed. Just two voices. After every call you get a Weave: a unique artwork shaped by how you talked, the rhythm, the silences, your evening and their morning. Never the words, and calls are never recorded. Every day at 17:00 UTC the whole world logs on together for the Daily Fuse.

records.name: KeepSimp
records.tagline: Free tools for PDFs, video and images that never upload
records.description: KeepSimp is 71 free tools that run in your browser, so your files never leave your device. Edit the words in a PDF, sign, fill and redact it; convert, trim and compress video; clean up and transcribe audio; take the background out of a photo; format JSON, test APIs and write code; plus calculators, a typing test and games. No account, no sign-up and nothing uploaded. It installs as an app and works offline once installed.

records.name: EveryTool
records.tagline: 100+ PDF, Image & QR tools in one free app - 100% on-device
records.description: EveryTool is a free all-in-one Android app from Evorenza with 100+ PDF, image, QR, audio & video tools. Convert, compress, scan, sign, protect and manage files directly on your device - fast, private, simple. Most tools run 100% on-device, so your PDFs and photos never leave your phone. No sign-up, use as guest, works offline, 18 languages. Features: PDF Merge/Split/Compress, PDF to Word, Background Remover, Passport Photo, QR Scanner, Video Compressor, OCR.

records.name: Zumungo AI driven Home Automation
records.tagline: Every brand, one home. Free. Just talk to your house.
records.description: Zumungo joins smart devices from any brand into one home: 50,000+ devices from 3,800+ brands. Zumungo is free, with no subscription, and runs on a small box in your house, so your devices and cameras stay private. No tech skills needed: draw your rooms, drag devices in, then just talk to your house. Zumungo AI designs your automations and family screens, plays music in every room, and watches your cameras with Vision AI.

records.name: Every Number
records.tagline: Turn your spreadsheet into a dashboard that shows its work
records.description: Drop in the spreadsheet or CSV you already report from. Every Number turns it into a dashboard where every number opens its receipt: the rows it counted, what it left out, and the math. The AI reads column names only and never types a number. Try it on your own file right now, no account needed.

records.name: Huggybugi
records.tagline: Your group chat lives on your desktop as pixel pets
records.description: Huggybugi turns your group chat into tiny pixel pets that walk along the bottom of your screen while you work. When a friend says something, a speech bubble pops up over their head. Feed them and they grow. Toss an acorn and they get dizzy. Draw one picture and it becomes your own character. Turn on focus mode to hide everyone for 25 minutes. Messages are locked so only your group can read them. Free on Mac and Windows, and you can reply from your phone.

records.name: Topicly
records.tagline: AI tutor for Indian government exam preparation
records.description: Choose your government exam, open a syllabus topic and study it with an AI tutor. Topicly connects syllabus maps with quizzes, mock tests and preparation tracking for Indian exam learners. Browse the syllabus without an account; tutoring and practice features have account and plan limits.

records.name: mappy
records.tagline: Turn messy thoughts into clear mind maps
records.description: Create practical mind maps, smooth and fast. Mappy is keyboard-friendly, and every node opens into a full page of notes where you can add images, equations, code and Markdown. There’s a built-in presentation mode. It’s an offline Mac app with no account or tracking, and you can sync through your own cloud. No subscription, just a one-time purchase of US$20.

records.name: Consault
records.tagline: Your AI assistant and its team take it from idea to done
records.description: Tell Lisa, your AI assistant, what you need in your own words. She and her AI team get it done: a live website or app, a booked appointment, a plumber shortlist with prices, a trip plan. She asks before she spends or publishes. 7 days free, no card.

records.name: Krumzi
records.tagline: Your own graphic designer
records.description: Tell Krumzi what you need in plain words: this week's posts, a carousel, a Reel, an event flyer. It designs each one from scratch in your brand and takes your feedback until it's right. Every part stays editable, and you can schedule to Instagram and Facebook.

records.name: PremiumZona
records.tagline: Discover creators and their exclusive content
records.description: PremiumZona is a digital platform where creators connect directly with their audiences through dedicated creator spaces, free and exclusive content, subscriptions, and interactive chat. Discover new creators, explore their communities, and access premium experiences in one place. For creators, PremiumZona provides an opportunity to build their own community, share content, and generate revenue through subscriptions and exclusive offerings.

records.name: Earmix
records.tagline: Per-app volume, EQ and output for your Mac
records.description: Turn Spotify down, the Zoom call up and that autoplay tab off. Earmix is a menu bar mixer that gives every Mac app and browser tab its own volume (up to 400%), EQ and output. Plus call ducking, call recording and an iPhone remote. Runs locally.

records.name: Lazy Scrum
records.tagline: Live sprint planning and Estimation on top of Jira
records.description: Jira add-ons bill every Jira user, even when only your Scrum Master needs them. LazyScrum sits on top of Jira: live planning and Estimation on a 30-minute timeline, synced back to Jira, plus sprint reports. Only Scrum Masters pay; the team joins free.

records.name: Glass Object Library
records.tagline: 799 clear 3D glass objects as transparent PNG and WebP
records.description: Hundreds of 3D glass objects as transparent 3000 px images in three angles, grouped by industry. Sorted into 19 industry folders. Drag them into Figma, Canva, Framer, Webflow, or slides. Clear glass that works on light and dark backgrounds. One-time purchase, no subscription. the whole set.

records.name: Kuai Videos Download
records.tagline: Download Kuaishou & Kwai videos free — no watermark, HD
records.description: Kuai Videos Download is a free online tool for saving Kuaishou and Kwai videos. Paste a video link and download it in the original quality, up to HD, without the moving watermark. It also offers the MP3 audio and the cover image, plus a bulk mode that saves up to 10 videos in one batch. It runs in any browser, on phone or computer — no app to install and no signup.

records.name: HomeworkHero: HomeworkHelp
records.tagline: A subject tutor walks you through your own question
records.description: Stuck on one question your notes don't explain? Post it free with your files, budget and deadline. Subject tutors send offers with a price and approach. Pick one, pay into escrow, ask for up to 3 revisions, and release payment only when you're happy.

records.name: SeninRandevun
records.tagline: Smart booking and business management in one platform
records.description: Senin Randevun is an all-in-one booking and business management platform. Customers can discover local businesses, compare services, and book appointments 24/7. Businesses can manage appointments, customers, employees, schedules, payments, and multiple branches from one smart dashboard. With CRM tools, analytics, automated reminders, and customer reviews, Senin Randevun simplifies daily operations and helps service businesses grow. Built in Türkiye, designed for a smarter future.

records.name: TheCoins
records.tagline: Own your regulars instead of renting them from delivery apps
records.description: Restaurants and shops pay delivery apps 15 to 25% on customers who already know them.
