records.description: SparklingPlay is a vertical short drama and mini drama app for iPhone: romance, billionaire CEO, heiress, revenge, werewolf and alpha, rebirth, contract marriage and fantasy series in short episodes. Watch the first episodes free on the website.

records.name: Kaptra
records.tagline: Captcha recognition API for developers
records.description: Kaptra is a captcha recognition API for developers and QA teams. You pay only when a task succeeds, and pricing is public. It follows a common task API structure, so switching is a one-line endpoint change. Built for automated testing and authorised data collection.

records.name: AgentFleet OSS
records.tagline: Every device a ship. One coordinated AI fleet.
records.description: Self-hosted orchestrator that turns every device into a ship in a cross-device AI fleet — auto-detects the agent CLIs you already have (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Aider, Gemini, Qwen...) and coordinates them across machines, LAN-first with a cloud-relay fallback.

records.name: Quill Pixel Game Maker
records.tagline: Make your first pixel game with your AI sidekick
records.description: Build 2D and 2.5D pixel-art games with your coding agent. Quill includes the full PDX Punk starter game, complete engine source, game assets, eight agent skills, a plugin, and tutorials. Create characters, worlds, music, and branching stories, then publish or sell your game. $25 once with one year of updates; AI subscriptions and usage are separate.

records.name: Al Marwa Travel
records.tagline: Umrah Packages from UK
records.description: Al Marwa Travel is a trusted, UK-based Hajj and Umrah travel agency offering all-inclusive, ATOL-protected packages from London, Birmingham, Manchester, and cities across the UK. We provide Umrah packages and Hajj packages in Economy, Deluxe, and 5★ options, including Ramadan Umrah, December Umrah, Easter Umrah, and family and group packages tailored to your budget and schedule.

records.name: TradeDesk
records.tagline: Trade documents, exchange rates and container planning
records.description: Create trade documents with live previews and PDF/Word downloads. Check ECB rates, plan container loads in 3D and explore freight, transit and customs references. Free, no signup, 11 languages. Shipping figures are estimates.

records.name: The Sad Days Umbrella PDF Ebook
records.tagline: The Sad Days Umbrella (English Edition) PDF Ebook
records.description: Gentle, picture book created to support children who have experienced the loss of a loved one. Through the story of Mateo and a magical umbrella that appears when his heart feels heaviest, this book offers comfort, understanding, and a quiet kind of hope. It serves as a loving tool to help children talk about their feelings, remember with warmth, and discover light even on the darkest days.

records.name: Arkush
records.tagline: Pull just the pages you need out of any PDF
records.description: Free PDF tool made by a musician: tap the pages you need from a songbook (or any PDF) and save them as a new file. Merge PDFs and photos, reorder, crop, clean up scans. No sign-up, no ads, and files never leave your device.

records.name: ocsheet
records.tagline: Free OC character sheet maker — visual blocks, tools & AI
records.description: OC Sheet is a free character sheet maker for artists, writers, and roleplayers. Build your OC's profile with visual blocks — radar charts, progress bars, star ratings — use free generators for names & personas, and turn your sheet into a finished AI illustration.

records.name: Argentina: Win a $2,500 Apple Gift Card
records.tagline: Indonesia & Argentina: Win a $2,500 Apple Gift Card
records.description: Living in Indonesia or Argentina? Join our free giveaway for $2,500 in Apple Gift Cards, open to 7 countries. Ends November 23, 2026.

records.name: Tubik Music Player
records.tagline: offline player for your own music, on your watch too
records.description: Tubik plays your own music and audiobooks offline, keeping your folder structure intact. Enjoy a free six-band equalizer, playback speed control, and sleep timer. Sync your tracks to Apple Watch, Wear OS, or Garmin for phone-free listening. No account or cloud required.

records.name: SantaWheel
records.tagline: Draw Secret Santa names in one click - free, no sign-up.
records.description: SantaWheel is a free Secret Santa generator. Paste your list, add exclusion rules so couples or managers never draw each other, then draw in one click. Send assignments by email or by private links - no participant email addresses needed. Organizer blind mode, self-join links, scheduled draws and anonymous questions included. Supports white elephant, yankee swap and dirty santa rules.

records.name: LINERUN: Tap & Flip Runner
records.tagline: Hold to run, release to flip. One-touch physics runner.
records.description: Hold to run. Release to flip. Land it clean. LINERUN is a one-touch, physics-based line runner you can play offline. One control, your thumb, and a line that doesn't end. Flip off ramps, stick perfect landings and see how far you can go. Hold to accelerate. Let go to launch. Every flip and every landing is real physics, not a canned animation. Land flat and it's a PERFECT. Over-rotate and it's a wipeout. You'll understand it in one second and still be chasing it at 100 km.

records.name: Pantry Scale: Recipe Box
records.tagline: Import, scale & cook recipes with what's in your pantry
records.description: Pantry Scale is a shared family recipe box for Android. Import a recipe from a link (free) or a TikTok/Reel (Premium), scale servings once so ingredients and the grocery list both update, and cook one step at a time with timers and read-aloud. Shared Shop syncs across your household. Free keeps 20 recipes; Premium ($6.99/mo or $49.99/yr, with trials) adds Cook Mode, nutrition, OCR and a household of 6.

records.name: OmniTok
records.tagline: Watch TikTok in Safari without app nags or limits
records.description: OmniTok is a Safari extension for iPhone that fixes TikTok’s mobile site: no app nags or scroll limits, a full-screen swipe player, scrub bar, hold for 2×, Picture in Picture and no repeat videos. Runs on your device, no account. Optional country feed, $1/mo.

records.name: Predictive Poetry
records.tagline: Discover unexpected connections between familiar phrases
records.description: Predictive Poetry is a collection of word games built on one idea: familiar phrases connect through shared words — nest egg → egg on your face → face the music. Build chains, uncover hidden links, and explore a living map of language through Connect, De-Code, Spines and more. Free to play.

records.name: PrivacyZIP
records.tagline: Free Online Tools. No Accounts. Privacy First.
records.description: PrivacyZip.com solves the problem of online privacy, data exposure, and unnecessary complexity when using everyday digital tools. Many people need simple online tools to clean text, inspect files, remove hidden metadata, convert documents, and protect personal information. However, many existing tools: Require users to create accounts. Place limits on free usage. Upload personal files to external servers. Collect unnecessary user data. Display excessive advertisements or require subscriptions.

records.name: Naijacloud
records.tagline: Deploy apps, databases, storage and email. Pay in naira.
records.description: Deploy web apps, Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, cron jobs, S3-compatible storage, email and domains from one dashboard. Billed hourly from a prepaid naira balance: bank transfer or card. Regions in Port Harcourt and Europe. Free tier.

records.name: Finance Calc Kit
records.tagline: 697 free finance calculators that show their formulas
records.description: Finance Calc Kit is a free library of 697 calculators across 19 categories - loans, mortgages, tax, retirement, savings, investments, paycheck and currency. Every calculator runs in the browser, shows the formula it uses and cites independent references, so a result can be checked instead of trusted. No account, no paywall, no stored inputs; a scenario can be encoded in a URL and shared.

records.name: TalkPix API
records.tagline: Turn a photo and a script into a talking video via API
records.description: New since our July launch: the TalkPix Developer API. The same lip-sync pipeline behind the web app is now a REST API. POST one portrait plus a script (30 voices, 10 languages) or your own audio, then poll the job or get a signed webhook when the MP4 is ready. POST /estimate shows the credit cost for free. You pay per rendered second from prepaid credits, no subscription, with automatic refunds if a render fails. Examples in curl, Node and Python, plus an npm client.

records.name: Apily
records.tagline: Low-cost access to leading AI models through one API
records.description: Save on AI API costs with Apily. Access leading AI models at low prices through OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Use one API key and a prepaid balance to integrate supported models into your applications, coding tools, and AI workflows. Choose the models you need and pay for usage without managing separate API accounts for each model provider.

records.name: Nexa by Ankor Business Solutions
records.tagline: AI tools that help small businesses get work done
records.description: Ankor Business Solutions sets up a ready-made AI assistant for small businesses in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, so admin and follow-ups take less time.

records.name: Anpheros Daily
records.tagline: Your family's health record, private and in your hands
records.description: Anpheros Daily keeps symptoms, medications, measurements, lab results and documents for you and your family in one place. Free in the browser, stored in the EU, and every doctor, clinic or AI access is approved by you and can be revoked.

records.name: Currency Counter
records.tagline: Financial Utility Tools for Cash tallies investments.
records.description: Professional offline cash denomination tally counter and financial calculator suite supporting 47+ countries and currencies worldwide. Features banknote and coin breakdown, amount in words, Fixed Deposit (FD), SIP, Recurring Deposit (RD), and Loan EMI calculators.

records.name: چیوو
records.tagline: Find and compare local services in Iran
records.description: در چیوو خدمات، مراکز تخصصی و کسب‌وکارهای مختلف را پیدا، بررسی و مقایسه کنید و بر اساس اطلاعات هر مجموعه، انتخاب آگاهانه‌تری داشته باشید.

records.name: Custom Box Packaging Cost Calculator
records.tagline: Estimate custom box costs before requesting a quote
records.description: Plan your custom packaging budget with an interactive online calculator from The Customized Packaging LLC. Select box styles, dimensions, order quantities, materials, printing, and finishing options to explore estimated packaging costs. Designed for ecommerce brands, startups, retailers, and businesses in the USA. Contact details are required to unlock detailed pricing estimates and a quotation PDF.

records.name: Uptendr
records.tagline: Nightly checks and tested fixes for your AI-built app
records.description: You built an app with AI and it works. Then a dependency gets a security hole, a page breaks, or the site goes down, and nobody is watching. Uptendr watches it for you. Connect your GitHub repo and paste your live URL. It checks uptime every 5 minutes, opens your key pages in a real browser, and scans for security problems every night. When something needs fixing, you get a small pull request, tested on your build first. You decide what gets merged. 14-day free trial.

records.name: SimpleRoute
records.tagline: B2B crypto swap infrastructure for wallets and platforms
records.description: SimpleRoute is enterprise-grade B2B software for crypto swaps, offering APIs, widgets, and custom integration options for crypto wallets, aggregators, comparison platforms, and exchange platforms. Through a technology partnership with SimpleSwap, SimpleRoute provides access to multiple CEX and DEX swap routes via a single integration. SimpleRoute helps crypto products introduce or expand embedded exchange functionality without building their own exchange infrastructure.

records.name: FounderSync
records.tagline: Find co-founder misalignment before you split equity
records.description: FounderSync helps co-founders compare their views on equity, money, roles, exits and more before signing an agreement. Each founder answers 21 questions privately, then you get one shared, score-free report of the differences worth discussing.

records.name: Kodense Agent OS
records.tagline: Private cloud AI agents with deterministic guardrails
records.description: Kodense Agent OS embeds autonomous AI agents directly inside your private cloud VPC—governed by mathematical guardrails, audited by human approval gates, and deployed by embedded senior systems engineers. • Zero-Egress VPC: Runs in client AWS/GCP/Azure or air-gapped enclaves with CMEK encryption. • 4 Autonomy Gates: Strict human sign-offs on Money, Customer, Production, and Legal actions. • Forward-Deployed Engineering: Senior engineers deploy inside your repos to live production in 6 weeks.

records.name: JetSift
records.tagline: Get your restaurant, cafe, & bar discovered by AI.
records.description: See how ChatGPT, Google AI, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity recommend your restaurant, café or bar, which places they name instead, and what to fix first.

records.name: Control Cloud
records.tagline: Live multi-cloud map and checks before terraform apply
records.description: Control Cloud reads your clouds and on-prem hosts through the provider API with read-only credentials, draws them as one live topology and checks every change against the live tenancy before apply: credentials and scope, network, hosts, template dependencies. The Terraform it generates ships to your repo and runs under your pipeline. No agents in your VMs. Free plan: 1 operator, 1 provider.

records.name: Adjudica.eu
records.tagline: Find and win public tenders in Portugal
records.description: Adjudica.eu collects every public tender published on Portugal's BASE portal each day and gives each one a match score for your company. See the maximum price, deadlines and documents; AdjudicAI reads the documents and lists what is required, and Competition shows the likely winning price and who usually bids for that buyer. Market insights, alerts and bid management included. Free to search; paid plans from €49/month.

records.name: Pixel Buddy
records.tagline: A pixel pet for Claude Code that grows from your work
records.description: A pixel pet for Claude Code. It lives in the terminal footer and above the prompt in VS Code and Cursor. Claude answers, it gets a cookie. Tests pass, a fish. You commit, a cake. It hatches tiny and grows up over 3 weeks. No network, no tokens, open source.

records.name: InvoPoint
records.tagline: Simple invoicing for small businesses. Free to get started.
records.description: InvoPoint is an easy-to-use invoicing platform built for freelancers, startups, and small businesses. Create professional invoices, manage customers, track payments, and stay organised without complicated accounting software. Get started with a free plan that includes up to 25 invoices per month. Spend less time on invoicing and more time growing your business.

records.name: Thai Supply Hub
records.tagline: Find Thai factories and suppliers, with registry data
records.description: Free directory of 14,000+ Thai factories, warehouses and logistics firms, with company-registry data (capital, age, industry) for 1,100+ of them. Browse by category, province or industrial estate, or send one RFQ and get matched with suppliers. Built for buyers sourcing OEM/ODM in Thailand. Buyers pay nothing and contact details are public.

records.name: TerraWatch AI Prompt Compressor
records.tagline: Auto-compress your AI prompts and cut token costs by 40%
records.description: TerraWatch compresses your prompts before they reach the AI — automatically. No extra clicks, no workflow changes. Just type and send like normal, and a toast shows you how many tokens were saved. Works as a Chrome extension (auto-compresses on submit) and a CLI for developers piping prompts into the API. Free. No account needed. Works on the major AI chat tools.

records.name: Jollys.Space
records.tagline: Ask Jolly
records.description: Jolly is your shopping assistant for India's homegrown brands. Ask Jolly in plain words or share a screenshot to get picks from 4,800+ independent brands. Save them in a Shopping Trip, share looks on Styleboards, and buy on each brand's own website.

records.name: Wimmlify
records.tagline: Your people. Your places. One picture to hang on the wall.
records.description: Upload photos of your people and places, and Wimmlify weaves them into one detail-rich picture to discover, point at and hang on the wall. AI-generated from your photos, editable until you order the print - up to A1.

records.name: Testhive
records.tagline: Create, deliver, grade, and analyze assessments in minutes
records.description: Testhive is an AI-native assessment platform for educators, training teams, and hiring organizations. Most teams juggle separate tools for question banks, delivery, proctoring, and grading. Testhive is the full stack: AI question creation from PDFs and course materials, secure delivery with passcodes and proctoring, instant MCQ scoring plus LLM rubric grading for essays, real-time analytics, and a Core API for LMS integration. Free to start. No credit card. Try it at testhiveapp.com.

records.name: APX
records.tagline: Your own team of AI agents, on your machine
records.description: APX is a free, open-source desktop app that runs your own team of AI agents on your machine. Organize specialists by project, delegate tasks, schedule routines, and connect your models and channels. Connected models and services may have separate costs.

records.name: Earlyward
records.tagline: Uptime monitoring that tells you why it went down
records.description: Know within a minute when your product breaks, and why: your latest release, a service like Stripe or AWS, or your own servers. No false alarms, incidents that write themselves, a status page that updates itself. Free while in beta.

records.name: Stanza Lift
records.tagline: The workout log whose coach plans every set
records.description: A calm gym log for iPhone and Apple Watch. Tap a set to log it, and Coach plans the next one: the weight and reps, from your history, how hard each set felt and how rested you are. Connect Claude or ChatGPT to your training. No account, no ads.

records.name: GlowFind
records.tagline: Find the cheapest shop for Korean skincare in Germany
records.description: GlowFind compares 563 Korean skincare products across 14 shops, from dm and Rossmann to stores in Korea, by the total price you actually pay: shipping, VAT and the new EU customs fee included. Free, no sign-up, daily price updates.

records.name: VocabHang
records.tagline: Spoken English tutor that teaches the words you lack
records.description: A vocabulary tutor you talk to. Press a button, have a real spoken conversation, and it works out which English words you know, teaches the ones just above your level when they fit, and brings them back until you use them. CEFR range, 30 free minutes a day.

records.name: WhenWeMeet?
records.tagline: Group Meeting Scheduling
records.description: WhenWeMeet helps you find the time that works for everyone. Share a single link, collect availability, and pick the best time without calendar conflicts.

records.name: Cloud Gazing
records.tagline: A cozy Roblox game where the sky follows real weather
records.description: Lie back on a grassy hill and watch the sky. Spot clouds shaped like whales, hearts and dragons, and fill your Cloud Book. The sky follows the real live weather of real places: rain, snow, sunsets and starry nights. Relaxing, non-addictive, free to play.

records.name: MyMemAlly
records.tagline: Location-based reminders and shareable digital photobooks
records.description: Remember what matters, where it matters. MyMemAlly lets you set reminders for a place without choosing a time—like returning a borrowed charger when you visit a friend’s home. You can also turn your photos into digital photobooks and share them with loved ones by link.

records.name: HEIC to JPG Free
records.tagline: Convert Apple HEIC photos to JPG 100% locally in browser
records.description: HEIC to JPG Free is a privacy-first web utility that converts Apple HEIC and HEIF photos to standard JPG format directly in your browser. Powered by WebAssembly and HTML5 Canvas, all image processing occurs client-side on your local device — zero uploads, zero server processing, and zero tracking. Features drag-and-drop batch conversions with instant zip downloads.

records.name: Zonewell
records.tagline: Snap Mac windows into layouts you design
records.description: Menu bar window manager for Mac. Draw your own zones, then drag a window or press a shortcut to snap it in. Separate layouts per display. FancyZones for macOS. A$14.99 once, 14-day free trial.

records.name: Orra
records.tagline: Vedic astrology from your real birth chart
records.description: Orra reads your real birth chart every day: Vedic, Western and Chinese astrology from your exact birth moment, built in Kerala. Free on the web without signing up: Kundli, Kundli matching (36 guna milan), the ten-check Porutham, daily Panchang and Rahu Kalam for 24 Indian cities, and all 27 nakshatras. The app adds daily readings, Ask the Stars and your people's charts. On Android, and as a web app on iPhone.

records.name: SpeedyIndex Rank Tracker
records.tagline: Google rank tracker without a subscription: pay per check
records.description: Track where your site ranks in Google by country or city, from Top-10 to Top-100. See up to 10 competitors, visibility and average position, and whether Google's AI Overview cites your pages. Every check saves the real Google results page. No subscription: pay per check, 2 tokens per keyword at Top-10 until Dec 2 (regular price 4). 100 free tokens on signup.

records.name: Plan Tally – Compare AU Mobile Plans
records.tagline: Your Phone Plan. The Real Cost. No Surprises.
records.description: PlanTally.au is an independent Australian mobile phone plan comparison platform designed to help consumers understand what their phone plans really cost and find better value. Unlike comparison websites that focus primarily on advertised monthly prices, Plan Tally calculates the true cost of mobile plans over 12 and 24 months, including introductory discounts, promotional periods and price increases.

records.name: ReachBoostly
records.tagline: Social media growth services — 283 services, 38 platforms
records.description: ReachBoostly offers social media growth services (followers, likes, views, comments) for LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X and 33 more platforms — 283 services across 38 platforms, simple online ordering with transparent per-100 starting prices, plus 22 free creator tools (hashtag, bio and caption generators, engagement calculator and more). Website https://reachboostly.com, tools at https://reachboostly.com/tools.html.

records.name: weedit Optimize PageSpeed
records.tagline: Speed up your storefront without editing theme code
records.description: Turn on one app embed in the theme editor, with no code changes. It preloads the main product, collection or article image, loads the next page while shoppers hover (Chrome and Edge), lazy loads images further down the page and can hold back scripts you list, like chat or review widgets, until the first interaction. Add ?weedit_speed=debug to any page to see Core Web Vitals and suggested fixes. Cart, checkout and account pages are always excluded, and the app needs no access to store data.

records.name: Needless Clock
records.tagline: Living clocks: fish, blocks & 10 more tiny worlds
records.description: Needless Clock turns time into tiny living scenes — fish swim into digits, blocks drop into 3D numbers, and 10 more worlds rebuild every minute. Made for desk and bedside. Runs 100% on-device: no account, no ads, no trackers. iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, Android + Mac screensaver.

records.name: Chatopia
records.tagline: Interest-driven social network with posts, photos, and polls
records.description: Chatopia is an interest-first social app where you can share what you love, discover new interests and connect with people who get you.

records.name: Reachy
records.tagline: LinkedIn AI agent: from buying signal to booked call
records.description: Reachy finds buyers from live LinkedIn signals (post reactions, events, groups, your website visitors), writes the outreach and answers every reply with your next step: a call, a trial, an interview. You approve each reply in one tap from Telegram, Slack, Discord, Claude or ChatGPT. AI included, runs from your own computer and LinkedIn account.

records.name: quiet-grid
records.tagline: Calm logic puzzles and word games, offline and ad-free
records.description: A calm place for logic puzzles: no ads, no account, no tracking. Quiet Grid is for Android players who want a good puzzle without anything pulling at their attention. Play 17 games, including Sudoku, Nonogram, Minesweeper, Star Battle, Takuzu, Word Search and 2048. Get a fresh puzzle every day, work through Journey chapters, and use hints that show the next logical step. Difficulty is graded by the logic each puzzle needs. Fully offline and open source (GPLv3).

records.name: Stamply: GPS Timestamp Camera
records.tagline: GPS timestamp photos and PDF reports
records.description: Stamply is a GPS timestamp camera that turns everyday photos into organized documentation. Add date, time, GPS location, custom stamps, and notes to your photos. Organize them into projects and create PDF photo reports. Perfect for work progress, property inspections, deliveries, and travel. Free on Android, with optional lifetime PLUS features. No ads, no subscription, and no account required.

records.name: Causly Server
records.tagline: Your agent writes code. Now it ships it and finds customers
records.description: Tell your agent: "ship this change, fix CI, then find me leads." Causly Server gives any MCP agent 245 tools to build, deploy, research and sell. Open source. One command: npx causly-server init. Approval prompts keep you in control.

records.name: TechScript
records.tagline: A programming language that reads like plain English
records.description: TechScript is a plain-English programming language with zero symbols and zero clutter. Instead of braces and semicolons, you write keywords — do, say, when, end — and TechScript compiles it to bytecode on a Rust VM or natively via LLVM. One tsc toolchain runs, builds, tests, lints and formats. Ships with 11 stdlib modules (including a built-in ai module), a package manager, LSP + VS Code support, and installers for Windows, Linux, macOS, Termux — pip install techscript. Free and MIT-licensed.

records.name: FeeMath
records.tagline: Real fees, real profit and AI listings for resellers
records.description: Most Etsy sellers think they pay 6.5%. On a typical sale it's closer to 11%. FeeMath shows what every platform really takes and helps you sell faster: drop in your Etsy statement CSV to see every fee and your profit per order, turn a photo into a ready-to-post listing with AI, and track real profit across eBay, Poshmark, Mercari and more. Fee calculators for 11 platforms are free. Starter unlocks every tool for $12 a month.

records.name: RagINS
records.tagline: Ask your company documents anything, with cited answers
records.description: RagINS turns every policy, contract, manual and report into something you can ask in plain language, with the source attached to every answer so it can be checked. Tables and section structure survive upload, each team gets its own knowledge channel and access list, and a reranking pass puts the right passage first. Deploy in your cloud or on your own servers.

records.name: Mediva One
records.tagline: Free pill reminders with family Circle of Care
records.description: Mediva One is a free pill reminder and medication tracker. Scan medicine labels, track refills, log doses, and invite family to a Circle of Care that alerts them if a dose is missed. Vitals from Health Connect sit next to your schedule. Wellness tool, not medical advice.

records.name: VOV Passport Explorer
records.tagline: See where 199 passports can travel, visa-free and beyond.
records.description: Free, no-signup passport explorer. Rank all 199 passports by visa-free destinations, click the world map, search any country, then open its detail page for the full visa table: visa-free, visa on arrival, eVisa, or visa required. In English and Spanish.

records.name: Regime Card
records.tagline: Is the market risk-on or risk-off? One number, every close
records.description: Regime Card reads the cross-asset picture (credit, volatility, rates and more) and settles US market risk into one number from 0 to 100, Risk-Off to Risk-On, after every close. Every reading goes into a public record you can check in your browser. Free iPhone app with widgets, the full history since 2008, and how stocks and crypto did in each regime.

records.name: Shndy
records.tagline: Gulf business, markets & AI brief in 3 languages
records.description: A free five-minute morning brief on Dubai, UAE and Gulf business, markets, real estate and AI, at 8am Dubai time in English, Russian and Arabic. AI-written from linked sources, every figure checked against independent outlets. Market board, daily word games, no paid placements.

records.name: FiveClose
records.tagline: A private circle that notices when a friend goes quiet
records.description: A free app for your closest people. It notices when someone goes quiet, plans your week around who needs you, and asks your circle to check on you if you go silent for a week. No feed, no likes. Simple version for seniors; 8 languages.

records.name: AI Agent Cost Calculator
records.tagline: See what your AI agent will cost, free.
records.description: A free calculator that shows what an AI agent will cost to run. Pick one of 21 models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or xAI, type your tokens per task and tasks per day, and see the cost per task, per day and for 30 days. Official prices. No sign-up.

records.name: TotalHeal AgentGate
records.tagline: Zero trust for AI agents: approve and log each MCP tool call
records.description: Zero trust for AI agents: every tool an agent calls through your MCP servers is checked against its allow list, approved by a person where it matters, and recorded. AgentGate sits between your AI agents and your MCP servers. Each agent gets its own identity and token and sees only the tools it is allowed; the servers’ own credentials stay with AgentGate. Made in India by Freaquer.

records.name: Reminder™ Lite
records.tagline: A free daily task and follow-up page for Notion
records.description: The free version of Reminder™ for Notion. Keep tasks, deadlines and follow-ups on one clean page, see what's due today and stop things slipping through the cracks. Need goals, routines and weekly reviews? Upgrade to Reminder™ v1.3.

records.name: PackNest
records.tagline: Smart packing lists from destination, dates, and activities
records.description: PackNest generates smart packing lists from your destination, dates and activities. Multiple bags and travelers, PDF export, fully offline.

records.name: Prompt Architect
records.tagline: Stop guessing your AI prompts. Architect them perfectly.
records.description: An intuitive tool built to structure, engineer, and refine high-converting prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, and Midjourney. Stop wasting time on trial-and-error.

records.name: AdCrewly
records.tagline: An AI marketing team for small businesses, approved by you
records.description: AdCrewly is an AI marketing agency for small businesses, in one login. A crew of eight AI marketers plans your marketing, writes posts, makes images and short video ads from your product photos, builds your website and landing pages, and checks your SEO. It posts to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Google Business Profile and more. Nothing goes live until you approve it. Start free with no card, or try any paid plan free for 14 days.

records.name: NotaGen
records.tagline: AI sheet music generator and audio-to-score transcription
records.description: NotaGen generates original classical-style sheet music from a period, composer style and ensemble, and transcribes uploaded recordings into editable scores. Export MusicXML, MIDI, ABC or PDF for MuseScore, Sibelius, Finale or Dorico. Best on clean solo recordings.

records.tagline: Make your product visible to ChatGPT, Perplexity & AI search

records.description: Glassbox compares skills from your CV with thousands of real tech job descriptions. Discover which skills are in demand, where your CV matches, and what you might be missing; with transparent results instead of a mysterious hiring score.

records.name: Reset Rune
records.tagline: Turn spare Codex resets into bottled runes
records.description: Codex banked resets expire, and you can only redeem when remaining usage is under 80%. Reset Rune is an open-source macOS menu bar app that watches expiry and can try to redeem before it disappears. It doesn’t bypass Codex’s rules; auto-use is off by default.

records.name: Chess Coach

records.description: Chess Coach turns a lost game into a lesson. Then train what broke: an opening trainer with spaced repetition, 25 pawn structures, the 100 essential endgames, calculation drills and the Woodpecker method, plus five courses from the rules to 1900+. Free to start, no ads.

records.name: Replix
records.tagline: Make product demo videos without recording your screen
records.description: Replix makes product demo videos from your code, so you never record your screen. Connect GitHub, pick a repo, and describe what the video should show. Export an MP4 in widescreen, vertical, or square. It runs in your browser and only reads your repos. Free while in beta.

records.name: Clutchbell

records.description: Live alerts for your sports bets. Scan your slip or type it in, from any sportsbook, and get a notification when it's close, when it hits, and at the final. No account linking. NBA, NFL, NHL, and college sports. Doesn't take bets or sell picks.

records.name: EarlyLore

records.name: Jarflow

Free to start on web and iOS, with an optional Jarflow+ plan for photos, more jars, and prompts.

records.name: NoCodeExport

Forms, CMS and shop back ends do not export: you get the pages as they are published.

records.name: DiskWise

records.name: KroLead CRM
records.tagline: Follow-ups, calls and WhatsApp leads in one Android CRM
records.description: KroLead is an Android CRM for small sales teams. Call Pilot shows lead context before you answer and logs notes after. 30-day Agenda, WhatsApp templates, works offline, 32 languages (22 Indian). Start with 1 month free, then from Rs 239/month ($8) per user.

records.name: Leadonspot. AI Revenue Operating System
records.tagline: AI Revenue Operating System
records.description: AI-native platform unifying CRM, unified inbox, data intelligence and voice agents for modern revenue teams.

records.name: AuraPost
records.tagline: Send Digital Postcards Online
records.description: AuraPost lets you turn your photos into digital postcards and send them online with delayed delivery.

records.name: Habitat Ledger
records.tagline: Records for your Texas wildlife or ag tax valuation
records.description: Record-keeping app for Texas landowners with an agricultural or wildlife management (1-d-1) tax valuation: log head counts, hay and leases or the 7 wildlife practices, scan receipts, fill in the PWD-888 annual report or print an ag proof packet, and create a year-end expense summary.

records.name: Glasses Frame Finder
records.tagline: Find glasses frames that suit your face shape. Free AI.
records.description: Free AI tool that finds glasses frames matched to your face shape from one photo. It reads your proportions from 68 landmarks, covers all seven face shapes, and returns the frame shapes that balance your face, the ones that work against it, and three named options to bring to your optician. 2 free scans a day, no sign-up, photos deleted right after processing.

records.name: Izaaja
records.tagline: Run Shopee, TikTok Shop and Lazada stores with one stock
records.description: Izaaja is a seller app for Shopee, TikTok Shop and Lazada across Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam and Taiwan. One stock is shared by every store and warehouse, so a sale on one marketplace lowers it everywhere and you stop overselling. Orders, labels and returns from all stores land in one queue. Copy products between stores, run promos, answer chats and read finance per store. Web and Android; the free plan has no shop limit.

records.name: Diligly
records.tagline: Investor-ready data rooms for startups
records.description: Prepare an investor-ready data room with a guided checklist, then share it through private read-only links. Set expiry and an optional NDA, and see when a link was opened. Confidential by default. Free to start.

records.name: RoleNudge
records.tagline: Free Portfolio & ATS-Friendly Resume Builder
records.description: RoleNudge helps job seekers build professional portfolios, compare their real experience with job requirements, identify skill gaps, and generate ATS-friendly resumes. AI suggestions are grounded in documented skills, projects, and experience rather than invented credentials RoleNudge helps job seekers turn their professional experience into a portfolio, understand how their skills and projects match job descriptions, and create tailored, ATS-friendly resumes.

records.name: Rowland
records.tagline: The AI right-of-way and land assistant
records.description: Row Bots run runsheets, reconcile decimals and research the record, then stop and ask before anything that matters.

records.name: WBX Sandbox
records.tagline: Secure cloud sandboxes for AI agents and developers
records.description: WBX Sandbox is a European compute platform for running code, testing applications, and executing AI agent workloads in isolated Firecracker microVMs and WebAssembly environments. Build with MCP, REST API, or Python SDK. Run background jobs, batch workflows, and collect logs, artifacts, and execution receipts. Built on carefully selected infrastructure, including second-life server hardware, with transparent usage-based pricing. Hosted in EU

records.name: Menu Pure
records.tagline: USA restaurant menus, prices, calories & deals.
records.description: Menu Pure (menupure.com) is an independent website that makes finding US restaurant menus simple and easy. It brings together menus, food items, prices, calories, deals and hours in one place, covering burgers, pizza, sandwiches, breakfast, lunch, dinner, desserts, drinks, salads, sides and kids' meals from popular US chains including IHOP, Cheesecake Factory, Dutch Bros, HEYTEA and Marco's Pizza. Menu Pure is not affiliated with or endorsed by any restaurant or brand featured on the site.

records.name: Flash Infinity AI
records.tagline: Flash Infinity AI — Beyond Limits
records.description: One Workspace. Infinite Possibilities. Flash Infinity AI brings the power of multiple AI technologies together to build apps, create websites, produce images and videos, generate documents, research, code, automate tasks and solve complex problems. One intelligent platform. Limitless possibilities.

records.name: Imposter Quest
records.tagline: Pass-and-play imposter game for 3+ players
records.description: Imposter Quest is a pass-and-play imposter game for iPhone. Gather 3 or more friends, pass one phone around, and everyone gets the secret word except the imposter. Give clues, debate, and vote out the spy before they blend in. Quick rounds, lots of word packs, and no accounts or extra devices needed. Free with in-app purchases.

records.name: memberships-kosha
records.tagline: Wellness that deepens with every visit.
records.description: Kosha Wellness Membership in Gurgaon” is all about making rest a regular part of your life, not a rare treat. In a city that never slows down, it’s easy to put self-care at the bottom of the list. This space is here to remind you to pause, breathe, and give your body the steady care it deserves. We talk about real routines, share practical tips, and explore how regular Ayurveda-inspired rituals can ease stress, tension, and tired days.

records.name: PsiDrive
records.tagline: Private file sharing with browser-side encryption
records.description: Send temporary files without requiring a guest account. PsiDrive encrypts files and filenames in the sender's browser with AES-256-GCM before upload, and recipients decrypt locally. Transfer keys remain in URL fragments rather than backend storage. Optional passwords, automatic expiry, QR sharing and delete-after-download are available.

records.name: How Far : Golf
records.tagline: Golf distance estimates using your iPhone camera and GPS
records.description: Measure approach, putting, and long-range golf distances with your iPhone. Use camera-based augmented reality for nearby targets or GPS map measurement for longer distances. No account or additional equipment required.

records.name: Zero Drift
records.tagline: Next.js + Sanity starter with the boring decisions made
records.description: Zero Drift is a Next.js 16 and Sanity 5 starter with the plumbing wired: a 14-block page builder, GROQ that resolves links and images before they reach a component, draft mode with live preview, a signed publish webhook, and fluid type anchored to your Figma frames. Four build guards fail the build when the setup drifts — a leaked secret, a block with no component, type that shrinks as the screen grows. JavaScript. €69, one developer, unlimited projects.

records.name: GrowMax: Height Predictor
records.tagline: Understand your growth. Build habits for full potential.
records.description: GrowMax is a height predictor and height calculator for teens, with daily stretches, sleep and food habits that support healthy growth. How tall will you be? GrowMax estimates your adult height using CDC growth data, your family's heights and a quick puberty check then gives you a daily plan of habits that support healthy growth. GrowMax is free to use with ads. Watch a short ad to unlock your exact prediction for 30 minutes, or go Premium to unlock everything and remove all ads.

records.name: Quick Data Insights
records.tagline: Preview SQLite Parquet Jupyter
records.description: Now FREE! Press Space in Finder and see what's inside your data files, without opening a database tool, a notebook server or a terminal. Quick Data Insights adds Quick Look previews for SQLite databases, Apache Parquet files and Jupyter notebooks. It works offline, needs no account, and never changes your files.

records.name: halfsize
records.tagline: Compress video to an exact size, locally
records.description: halfsize compresses a video to an exact target size — 20 MB for Discord or WeChat, 16 MB for WhatsApp, 20–25 MB for email — then reports the measured VMAF and SSIM quality loss. It computes the bitrate budget, downscales when 720p beats a starved 1080p, and encodes in two passes. Runs fully locally on FFmpeg: no upload, no account, no quota, no watermark. Free, MIT licensed, with a local web UI, batch mode and JSON output.

records.name: Foodie Moiety
records.tagline: Premium cooking companion for your Mac
records.description: Foodie Moiety is a recipe app for cooking with your hands full: one step at a time, with pictures and video, driven by voice. Save the parts you make again and again (a crust, a sauce, a side) as "moieties" and drop them into new recipes. Build recipes, let Claude write them, turn them into digital cookbooks and share them or sell them on the community website. Free to download; early creators get full creator tier access for free using the promo code "PRODUCTHUNT" on their free account page.

records.name: ScriptForge
records.tagline: Turn plain text and LaTeX into handwritten notes
records.description: ScriptForge is a free, offline browser studio that compiles plain text, LaTeX and declarative sketches into handwritten notebook pages and multi-page PDFs. No account, no cloud, no build step. 40+ diagram solvers, A3 cheat sheets, MCP/CLI.

records.name: Life Milestone
records.tagline: Capture life's milestones and collect achievement badges
records.description: Turn life's firsts and everyday progress into milestones you can collect. Record memories with text, photos, video and voice, earn achievement badges, and follow your growth across life areas. From your baby's first steps to your first 5K, keep the moments that matter on your timeline. Built for iPhone and iPad, with no account required and optional backup to your own iCloud.

records.name: Stillwood
records.tagline: A website blocker that asks why you're opening the site
records.description: Stillwood pauses YouTube, Reddit or any site on your list for a few seconds and asks what's pulling you there. Each answer gets a small way back to work, and every 20 focused minutes grows a ring. Free, no account, your data stays on your computer.

records.name: Shen AI
records.tagline: Unlock AI health monitoring
records.description: Shen AI is a camera-based health screening platform designed for healthcare and insurance leaders who want to provide their customers with immediate, actionable health insights. With a simple 30-second face scan, Shen AI can track over 30 vital health markers, including blood pressure, heart rate or HRV.

records.name: Paytimate
records.tagline: Bill faster, get repeat customers, sell more per order
records.description: Fast, offline-ready POS for restaurants, cafés and retail. WhatsApp CRM brings customers back, and AI suggests items to pair with each order to raise bill value. Includes KOT routing and tax automation. Try free for 7 days.

records.name: TikTik
records.tagline: TikTok video downloader without watermark
records.description: Free web tool to download TikTok videos without watermark in HD, save photo slideshows as JPG or ZIP, and convert TikTok to MP3. Works in any browser on iPhone, Android, Windows and Mac. No app, no sign-up, 21 languages.

records.name: AI NMR Spectroscopy for Modern Labs
records.tagline: AI NMR Spectroscopy Advances Modern Laboratory Research
records.description: Modern laboratories are embracing AI NMR Spectroscopy to explore more efficient approaches to chemical research. ROMBO AI develops intelligent analytical solutions that help researchers examine spectral signals, investigate molecular structures, and interpret complex NMR data, supporting advanced scientific workflows and chemical characterization across research and industrial applications.

records.name: Influencer Invoice Generator
records.tagline: Free Influencer Invoice Generator
records.description: Create professional influencer invoices in minutes with our free invoice generator. Generate GST invoices with CGST, SGST, or IGST, calculate TDS, add SAC code 998361, and choose from 8 invoice designs. Download invoices instantly as PDFs without signing up. Your data isn't stored unless you choose to save it.

records.name: GigNBizz
records.tagline: A platform for music lovers
records.description: GigNBizz is a free social platform where musicians find gigs at local businesses, a place for musicians to promote their music using Agentic tools, and music lovers to share their music and sing song covers.

records.name: Monstera PDF Editor
records.tagline: A free, open-source PDF editor with 150+ tools for Windows
records.description: Monstera PDF Editor is a completely free, open-source PDF editor for Windows 10 and 11, available on the Microsoft Store. It offers more than 150 professional tools. With Monstera you can edit PDFs, manage pages, create forms, redact sensitive information, sign documents, compare files, convert formats, recognize scanned text and much more. Enjoy powerful PDF editing without subscriptions, accounts, watermarks or hidden fees.

records.name: PlanarHQ
records.tagline: A task tracker that responds instantly and works offline
records.description: Task tracker with boards, lists, calendar, Timeline, docs and chat. Works offline and responds instantly. Free to self-host or $10/month in the cloud. An alternative to ClickUp, Jira and Linear.

records.name: Dubai Property Snagging
records.tagline: Inspect Before you Invest
records.description: UAE home inspections: 400+ checkpoints, thermal imaging included, report in 6 working hours. Free 360° tour for Product Hunt members.

records.name: AndaDownloader
records.tagline: Free Online Video Downloader
records.description: Free online downloader for video, audio and stories from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and 50+ more sites. No signup, no software.

records.name: SHOTos
records.tagline: Free AI workflows from brief to handoff
records.description: Use the AI assistant you already have. Start with your context, make a small, testable bet and get a result you can review and hand over. SHOTos has 88 free, open-source skills for proposals, product briefs, campaigns and more.

records.name: Uplumo
records.tagline: AI search analytics with honest pricing
records.description: SEO + AI-search toolkit for founders and small agencies: keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, Search Console, and which AI assistants mention you. Works with AI agents via MCP. Free plan; paid from $15/mo.

records.name: Flexela One
records.tagline: Your email, office suite and digital world in one place
records.description: Flexela One is building an all-in-one digital platform for individuals and businesses, combining email, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, business networking and virtual offices.

records.name: Safe Response AI
records.tagline: Reply to tough messages without escalating the fight
records.description: Got a hard text from your ex, partner, family or boss? Safe Response AI analyzes the message and suggests calm replies in different tones (direct, warm, firm), explains what's behind it, and helps you set boundaries without making things worse.

records.name: FocusFlow Tech
records.tagline: Verified, US-exclusive directory for certified truck optics
records.description: FocusFlow-Tech is a secure, US-exclusive platform for truck lighting enthusiasts. Operating under a strict user protection charter, our interactive directory ensures absolute transaction safety and compliance. We eliminate uncertified parts by connecting users directly with official DOT/SAE compliant catalogs from top brands like Anzo USA and AlphaRex, backed by full factory warranties.

records.name: Dawmly
records.tagline: Arabic-first attendance and payroll app for growing teams
records.description: Dawmly is an Arabic-first attendance and workforce app. Employees clock in from their phones with GPS, even offline, and managers get lateness, overtime, shifts, leave and payroll in one place. Free for up to 3 employees.

records.name: LesX
records.tagline: Mood journaling and community for LGBTQ+ women
records.description: LesX gives LGBTQ+ women a place to check in with their emotions, keep private journal entries, and connect with a peer community. Explore tarot reflection prompts, creative self-expression, and period tracking on iOS and Android.

records.name: Nexus
records.tagline: An AI that asks strangers who's calling, before you pick up
records.description: Contacts ring through. Most callers you don't know talk to an AI that asks who they are and why. Spam-list and no-caller-ID calls are refused, real callers get put through, and voicemails come as text. Keep your number. Android and iPhone.

records.name: Toaster
records.tagline: Play any song and watch it turn into live code
records.description: Toaster listens to whatever is playing and writes it as live Strudel code: kick, clap, hats, bass line and chords, lit up as the song hits them, over scenes that move with it. Spotify search in the apps. Free, open source, in a browser or on Mac and Windows.

records.name: Dlist
records.tagline: Zero-latency, local-first browser new tab dashboard
records.description: Most new tab extensions suffer from heavy scripts, tracking pixels, and sluggish load times. Dlist is built for speed and privacy. It transforms your browser's default new tab into a minimal, zero-latency productivity dashboard that loads instantly. Key Features: - Ultra-Fast Performance - Local-First Architecture - Privacy-Focused - Minimal Aesthetics

records.name: Pulsari
records.tagline: A practice metronome you feel on your Apple Watch
records.description: Your Apple Watch taps the beat on your wrist while your iPhone on the music stand flashes it, in sync. Loop the hard bars and climb the tempo once they're clean. Snap a photo of your part and it plays the roadmap. Free metronome, never a subscriptio

records.name: GlideConvert
records.tagline: Convert images, video & PDF without uploading anything
records.description: Convert, compress and resize images, video, audio and PDF right in your browser. Files are never uploaded — 300+ free tools, no sign-up. HEIC to JPG, MOV to MP4, compress PDFs and images to an exact size (100 KB, 200 KB…), merge and unlock PDFs, OCR and more.

records.name: PC Link
records.tagline: Your PC in your pocket — files & screen from your phone
records.description: Access your Windows PC from your Android phone, anywhere — browse and transfer files and view/control your screen over your own private, encrypted connection. No port forwarding.

records.name: VouchRabbit
records.tagline: Show your Google, G2 and Trustpilot reviews on your website
records.description: VouchRabbit pulls the customer reviews a business has already earned from Google, Trustpilot, G2, Capterra, Yelp, Clutch, Fiverr, Upwork, Freelancer.com, Facebook, the App Store, Google Play and more, lets the owner approve exactly what goes public, and publishes that proof as an embeddable website widget and a weekly sales-deck PDF or PowerPoint slide.

records.name: Mirivilo
records.tagline: Your iPhone, backed up and within reach.
records.description: A Mac app for iPhone and iPad. Back up without iCloud, by cable or over Wi-Fi. Read and export messages, contacts, notes and voicemail. Restore all of it, or only what you need. Your backups never leave your Mac. $10 a year per iPhone or iPad, plus tax.

records.name: ManimFlow
records.tagline: Generate Manim animations from natural language prompts
records.description: ManimFlow is an open-source tool built to help create mathematical and conceptual animations using Manim via an autonomous coding agent loop. It takes a prompt, drafts a scene plan, runs Manim code, observes errors, and iterates until an MP4 is generated, with optional layout review and narration.

records.name: AI Dance Flow
records.tagline: Turn a photo or character into a short dance clip
records.description: Choose a preset dance, add one photo or original character, and generate a short MP4 clip. Available routines include K-pop, anime and pet-themed dances. Generation uses paid credits; browsing previews is free. Some templates remain preview-only.

records.name: Trysse
records.tagline: Turn Amazon product links into AI outfit previews
records.description: Trysse turns Amazon product links into outfit inspiration. Paste a supported Amazon product URL to fetch its images in one click, choose a garment, and preview it on your own photo with AI. You can also upload clothing images directly. Explore outfits, compare styles, and plan your wardrobe with private creations and one-time credit packs. AI previews are visual concepts, not size or fit guarantees.

records.name: Lichii Emulator
records.tagline: Independent guides for Lichii setup and compatibility
records.description: An independent guide to the experimental Lichii emulator. Find official downloads for Windows, Linux, and Apple Silicon Mac, compare community compatibility reports, and troubleshoot setup, crashes, and graphics issues. Results vary by game and hardware. This guide is not affiliated with the Lichii project or Nintendo.

records.name: Syntax Energy Co.
records.tagline: Games, physics sims and dev tools. Free, no signup.
records.description: Syntax Energy is a fake power company that harvests syntax errors, and a real playground: 26 browser games, 27 interactive physics simulators and 35 handy tools. Daily puzzles, achievements and leaderboards. Free, with no signup, no ads and no tracking.

records.name: Fairaven
records.tagline: Professional Profiles & Talent Discovery
records.description: For professionals and recruiting teams in India: create a profile, compare resumes, and discover candidates with permission on Fairaven.

records.name: Leah Books
records.tagline: Bookkeeping software made by accountants
records.description: Invoices, bills, bank feeds, receipts, reconciliation, paper-check payroll and reports in one place, for small businesses. Made by accountants. Plans from $29/month with a 15-day free trial. Free how-to videos for every step.

records.name: DealTug
records.tagline: Tug the Best Deals to You. Verified Amazon deals.
records.description: DealTug helps US shoppers find verified Amazon discounts and promo codes. We re-check promo codes every 4 hours, refresh deal prices daily, and score every offer with a 5-dimension Deal Score — plus transparent Amazon Associates disclosure on every page.

records.name: VisaApply.org
records.tagline: World's largest visa portal-249 countries, 14,084+live visas
records.description: World's largest visa portal - 249 countries, 14K+ visas, 61,752 routes, 10 langs auto, daily 3AM sync from 249 gov sites, live time/weather/currency

records.name: Bump
records.tagline: Lead follow-up texts in your voice, from your own number
records.description: Bump is an iPhone app for following up by text. It knows who's due, writes each text in your own voice, and you send them from your own number with one tap, or the whole day's with Send all. Texts go one-to-one, so a list of 50 still reads like you texted each person. Nothing goes out until you tap Send. Built for salespeople and small businesses in real estate, insurance, solar, contractors, mortgage and more. Your first 30 texts are free.

records.name: AuditBeacon
records.tagline: Free SEO/AEO/GEO auditor — 52 checks, no signup
records.description: Paste any URL and get 52 checks across 13 categories — classic SEO plus AEO (answer-engine optimization) and GEO (generative-engine optimization) for the AI-search era. Every issue ships with plain-language fix guidance, not just a score. No account, no signup, no paywall — it just runs. Also available as a Chrome extension for one-click audits of any page you're on.

records.name: Kelunio
records.tagline: Local help for your home – cleaning, Home Watch & more
records.description: Kelunio is a global, multilingual marketplace for local everyday help and home services. Homeowners and holiday-home owners find local providers for cleaning, garden work, handyman jobs, moving help and Home Watch – exterior checks of your property while you are away. Providers create a free basic listing, and customers contact them directly.

records.name: BargainBadger
records.tagline: Compare one product across 9 stores. Best price wins.
records.description: BargainBadger compares one product across 9 stores — Temu, AliExpress, DHgate, Shein, Vinted, Alibaba, TikTok Shop, Etsy and Amazon. It shows the total (price + shipping + fees) and picks a Best Buy and Best Rated per search. FREE until ~Nov 11, 2026 13:30 UTC on Gumroad and the website getbargainbadger.com — then $4.99/month (downloads made during the free window stay free while installed). First release: 5,000 downloads.

records.name: Static AI Block
records.tagline: Add AI to any static site with one script tag. Free & MIT
records.description: Twelve copy-paste AI blocks for any static website: ask this page, summarize, translate, FAQ bot, extract to JSON, alt text, quiz, rewrite, smart search and more. Each block is plain HTML + vanilla JS under 60 lines: paste it, replace one key, done. No backend, no framework, no build step. Blocks call OneTag AI from the browser with one script tag, and every account gets 1,000,000 free tokens. MIT licensed, with a live gallery to try every block.

records.name: NightStay
records.tagline: Hotel booking system with an AI assistant on WhatsApp
records.description: NightStay runs your hotel in one place: a direct booking website, calendar, rooms & rates, payments, expenses and reports. Its AI assistant answers guests on WhatsApp and Facebook, checks availability, books the room and sends a payment link.

records.name: Batch XY Plot Pack
records.tagline: Turn matching CSV runs into an XY plot pack, locally
records.description: Compare repeated numeric CSV/TSV runs without writing a plotting script. Choose X and Y once to create an overlay and a chart per file, then export PNG, SVG or ZIP. A local HTML app with reusable JSON presets, synthetic examples and English/Chinese guides. Early release. Matching column names and order required; no Excel files, fitting or smoothing. One-time purchase from $1.99.

records.name: Microtrabajos Latino America
records.tagline: arte
records.description: Marketplace de microtareas: ganá por tarea completada o publicá tu campaña y revisá las pruebas. Saldo dentro de la app y retiros por transferencia.

records.name: Flashlingo
records.tagline: Free Vocabulary Flashcard Quizzes in 12 Languages
records.description: Learn vocabulary in 12 languages with free, timed flashcard quizzes: French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Vietnamese, Indonesian and Hindi. 1,500 words per language.

records.name: CaloLift
records.tagline: Track what you eat and what you lift, in one app
records.description: CaloLift puts your food and your training in one app. Log a meal by photo, voice, barcode or text: AI estimates the foods and macros, and you check them before saving. Log every set and rep with your last session shown as you lift, plus routines, rest timers and PRs. See calories, protein and training side by side, ask the AI coach about your own logs, and get meal ideas that fit what you have left. Free on iPhone and Android, with an optional Pro plan.

records.name: Tenzlo
records.tagline: Rental management: rent, tenants, leases, meters, staff
records.description: Tenzlo is rental property management software. Track rent, give tenants a portal, manage leases and deposits, bill meters and run staff payroll.

records.name: Lepone31 AI & B2B Intelligence Suite
records.tagline: 19 Pay-Per-Event APIs for AI RAG, Reels OCR & B2B Signal
records.description: A suite of 19 zero-proxy, Pay-Per-Event APIs on Apify Store built for AI agents, RAG pipelines, and n8n/Make automations. Includes Instagram Reels Deep Intelligence (C++ Tesseract Visual Hook OCR + Faster-Whisper STT), <0.4s YouTube Transcript Pro, 5-platform ATS Hiring Signals, and 8-marketplace Amazon Sales Velocity intelligence. No monthly subscription — works out of the box with Apify's $5 free monthly credits.

records.name: لایحه‌یار
records.tagline: همیار وکیل
records.description: لایحه‌یار، فضای کار هوشمند حقوقی برای وکلا؛ مدیریت پرونده، نگارش و بازبینی لایحه، دادخواست و متون حقوقی فارسی با کمک هوش مصنوعی.

records.name: FlowGlyph
records.tagline: Your UiPath, SAP and BPMN automations, typed, for AI agents
records.description: Reads UiPath, SAP OData and CPI, BPMN, n8n and OpenAPI with parsers, no model, into one typed catalog: inputs, effects, whether a retry is a repeat. From it: a retry-safety report, an LLM wiki, context for coding agents, an MCP gateway with policy and audit.

records.name: FindDevs
records.tagline: Compare 3 Fixed Developer Quotes. Free.
records.description: FindDevs is Australia's network for comparing developer quotes. Post a brief and get 3 free, fixed-price quotes from checked Australian developers within two business days.

records.name: Apparel Diary
records.tagline: Garment Factory Calculators and Guides
records.description: Free garment and textile calculators and practical guides: SMV, CM costing, DHU, AQL, yarn count and fabric GSM, with worked examples for factories.

records.name: CollaboTokyo
records.tagline: Explore a virtual Tokyo to network, market, and collaborate
records.description: What if networking felt more like exploring a city than scrolling through a feed? CollaboTokyo is a virtual Tokyo where creators, builders, entrepreneurs, and brands from around the world meet, discover projects, and collaborate. The city is broken up into districts & neighborhoods each with its own category/topic so you can explore and share project, work, and ideas with people in the same niche. Explore the city. Meet people. Make things happen.

records.name: Guess the Real Size
records.tagline: Guess country sizes in a five-question geography game
records.description: A free browser geography game. Compare two country outlines, adjust an area-ratio slider or enter a number, then reveal the answer and score. Each untimed round has five questions. No login required. Map estimates use Natural Earth data.

records.name: Singapore Proxy MCP
records.tagline: Give your AI agent a real Singapore mobile IP
records.description: New: a hosted MCP server for Claude, Cursor and Cline. Add one URL and an API key header, and your agent can fetch pages and run Google searches from a dedicated Singtel or M1 mobile line in Singapore, so it sees local prices, search results and geo-locked pages like a phone there would. Four tools: fetch_url, search_google (Singapore-localised), rotate_ip and my_proxy_status. Nothing to install. Free 24-hour trial with 10GB, then $4 a day, $13 a week or from $40 a month.

records.name: TakeReview
records.tagline: Review pauses and English retakes offline on Apple Silicon
records.description: TakeReview helps review pauses and repeated English takes, listen and manually choose cuts, then export a new MP4 offline. Includes the English model, processing engine and user guide. Apple Silicon Mac only; not notarized. Requires H.264 + AAC, 8-bit SDR, constant frame rate and 1080p or lower. Free demo: one video up to 60s. Full: 5 videos per batch, up to 10 min/2 GB each, $29 once. No cloud upload or subscription.

records.name: tealmac UI
records.tagline: The shadcn registry your AI coding agent can search
records.description: 647 free MIT components, hooks and blocks you install with the shadcn CLI, 2,040 themes, and a hosted MCP server so an AI coding agent can find and install them. Pro adds blocks, templates and starter apps: $59 until 15 Nov, then $99.

records.name: Clogmeter
records.tagline: Weigh AGENTS.md and Cursor rules in your browser
records.description: Free browser-only inspector for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules and skills. See token weight, duplicates and conflicting always/never rules, then export a trimmed copy. Nothing is uploaded. Pro is $15/mo for named projects and local history.

records.name: ThemeDrop
records.tagline: AI Shopify store builder: a full store in 30 seconds

Spend less time chasing paperwork and more time understanding the financial picture.

records.name: WBlur

Day Pass $0.99/24h; Zambo Pass $29/30 days ($19 for $ZAMBO holders); Lifetime $250.
