records.description: 20–30 Minute Arrival | Genuine Fuel | Reliable Service Fast Fuel Delivery | Genuine Petrol | Dubai-Wide Coverage

records.name: DearRewind
records.tagline: Tell the story behind a song. Watch it play back. — DearMate
records.description: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. Pick a song that takes you somewhere and tell the memory behind it in a one-minute interview. DearRewind turns it into a rewind: your story rising line by line, in time with the music, over film-like pictures. Then see where the same song took strangers.

records.name: looplog
records.tagline: Build better habits with private, on-device AI.
records.description: Turn your goals into habits with on-device AI. Track progress, build routines, and stay consistent with a private, offline-first habit tracker for Android.

records.name: Wallfinch
records.tagline: Wallpaper Finder for Windows
records.description: Every wallpaper site, one window. Free for Windows, with no limits.

records.name: Menubloom
records.tagline: The right-click menu your Mac is missing
records.description: New File, Copy Path, Cut & Paste, Open in Terminal and more, right in Finder's right-click menu. Free, open source, signed and notarized. One switch in Settings, no folder permissions needed.

records.name: Sarfaraz Khan
records.tagline: Full Stack Developer
records.description: Portfolio of Sarfaraz Khan - 18 year old Full Stack Developer specializing in Laravel, PHP, JavaScript

records.name: Nexeras Innovation
records.tagline: Engineering the Digital Future
records.description: We design, engineer and scale digital products, enterprise systems and intelligent software.

records.name: Gimbap
records.tagline: Your Mac's Dock, with themes
records.description: Gimbap is a macOS Dock alternative with themes full of cool visuals and animations. I tried to make it work as much like the original Dock as possible. Try it free for 7 days.

records.name: RoomClash
records.tagline: Glow up your room. Crown your pet. Clash your friends.
records.description: Turn a photo of your room into an AI makeover, with you, your pet or an avatar as the star. Battle a friend 1v1 while the crowd votes for 24 hours. Weekly Clash Cup, Pet Face-Off and a Dogs vs Cats Team War. Free, 13+, built to be kind.

records.name: Execuday
records.tagline: Tasks, team calendar & time off for small teams
records.description: Execuday brings tasks, a shared team calendar and time off into one app for small teams. Get a heads-up when a task is due on someone’s day off. Free covers 3 members and 3 projects. One flat price per team, not per person.

records.name: Elpis
records.tagline: Payment controls for agents
records.description: Set spending rules, verify agreed work, and keep authorization separate from payment execution.

records.name: API Samurai Free Tools
records.tagline: Free ad and Telegram lookups, no signup
records.description: Three free lookups: a brand's longest-running Facebook ads, any public Telegram channel's real reach, and whether a company runs Google Ads. No signup, 5 lookups a day.

records.name: Wrkful
records.tagline: Design the room. Run the studio. Get paid.
records.description: Your supplier already sent the numbers. Why type them twice? Wrkful uses AI to pull line items from supplier quotes and spec sheets so you can review them and build a client-ready quote or BOQ. Give clients a link to review and approve the quote, then send the invoice. Keep it all with the moodboard and project budget. Built for interior design studios. Try it free for 14 days.

records.name: NowMine
records.tagline: Turn SaaS distribution into a 15-minute daily quest
records.description: Turn SaaS distribution into a 15-minute daily quest. Build your launch habit with NowMine.

records.name: TMX by TLX Mobility
records.tagline: Sales and distribution management for FMCG distributors
records.description: TMX is a sales and distribution management platform from TLX Mobility, a Techlogix company. It connects distributors, field sales teams and retail outlets with order capture, route planning, inventory and analytics.

records.name: Scope
records.tagline: Carbon Tracking Software for Business & Events
records.description: Track, manage and reduce your carbon emissions with Scope. Easy-to-use carbon tracking and carbon reporting software for businesses and events.

records.name: $2,500 Apple Gift Card Giveaway Rules,
records.tagline: $2,500 Apple Gift Card Giveaway Rules, Dates and Prize
records.description: Read the full rules: who can enter, how the winner is picked and when the prize is sent. Not affiliated with Apple.

records.name: Rising Sign Calculator
records.tagline: Find your rising sign free with our ascendant calculator
records.description: A free rising sign calculator that finds your ascendant sign, exact zodiac degree, and decan from your birth date, birth time, and birth city.

records.name: Can Enter the $2,500 Apple Giveaway?
records.tagline: Which Countries Can Enter the $2,500 Apple Giveaway?
records.description: Argentina, Canada, Germany, Indonesia, Turkey, the USA and Vietnam are eligible. See the rules and enter free before November 23.

records.name: Deedline
records.tagline: Distressed property leads from county records
records.description: Deedline turns county public records into distressed property leads: probate, pre-foreclosure, auctions, tax deeds and liens, matched to the property and owner, scored 0–100, often the day they're filed. Browse every lead free in all 67 Florida counties.

records.name: Cartly
records.tagline: AI-assisted shopping with a knowledge graph of every shopper
records.description: Cartly is a complete fashion store for Bangladesh with Pip, an AI shopping assistant that chats and talks in English, Bangla or Banglish. Pip recommends from the store's own catalogue, adds to the bag and starts a virtual try-on. Cartly learns what each shopper likes and emails them when something they wanted arrives. bKash, Nagad, cards and cash on delivery; own riders or Pathao, Steadfast and RedX; a full admin panel. One Docker command runs it all.

records.name: FrilaHub
records.tagline: Know which freelance jobs actually pay for your time
records.description: FrilaHub is project management with the finances built in, for freelancers, solo businesses and small agencies. Each project keeps its client, tasks, deadlines, hours, installments and costs together, so you see what was sold, what came in, what is late and the margin of every job. A summary shows revenue and profit per hour by project, a simplified P&L and your most profitable clients. Kanban or list, client CRM, calendar and team permissions. Free plan forever; 7-day Pro trial.

records.name: Morphix
records.tagline: AI image & video generator with an Agent, Nodes, 50+ models
records.description: Morphix is an AI studio for images, video and audio. New since our first launch: Agent: a GPT chat inside Morphix that generates images, video and voice right in the conversation Nodes: chain models into reusable workflows Apps: one-click tools built from workflows, shareable by private link MCP: use Morphix from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Gemini 50+ models: Kling 4.0, Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Seedance 2.5, Nano Banana Pro and more

records.name: Kettle
records.tagline: The helper in your family group chat
records.description: Kettle is a helper in your family's group chat. There's no app and nothing to set up: text it on its own, or start a group message with "Kettle." It remembers the details you tell it, plans dinners around your week, builds a grocery cart for you to review and check out, and sends group or private reminders plus a short morning brief. Getting started: text hi, each person texts once so it knows who's who, then add Kettle to the group. 7 days free, then $19 a month for the whole family.

records.name: Agent Adapter
records.tagline: A new agentic framework that runs your tools anywhere
records.description: Agent Adapter is a new open-source agentic framework that runs your AI agent tools anywhere, safely. Write a tool once as a plain function and use it in LangChain, CrewAI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents and 16 more, or call it from TypeScript, Java, C#, Go and 5 more languages. One executor adds approvals, budgets, cost and traces to every call. Works in your AI IDE: one command adds the skill to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot and 60+ coding agents. Free, Apache-2.0.

records.name: Phext Edit
records.tagline: Write in 11 dimensions: plain text, no lock-in.
records.description: Phext is plain text in 11 dimensions: a file of scrolls, each at a coordinate - and still plain text. Phext Edit is its web editor. Navigate by coordinate, browse the dimension tree, search, edit any scroll and save to the server. Live demo, no sign-in; sign in with Google, GitHub, or X for your own files. Free no-login utilities: Up Goer Five, Singular, coordinate TTS, Phext Previewer, and Learn You Phext - a phext tutorial that is itself a phext. Open source (phext-lattice). No ads, ever.

records.name: RunPR
records.tagline: Find the story, research the reporter, draft the pitch
records.description: RunPR is software for PR agencies, in-house teams and consultants. It finds stories relevant to each client, researches the reporters covering them and drafts pitches grounded in the client's expertise. You see the evidence beside each draft and can edit all of it. Your team keeps strategy, relationships and the decision to send. Monthly reports cover outreach, captured replies, source-supported coverage and AI visibility. Try the public demo at runpr.ai/walkthrough.

records.name: Co-Review
records.tagline: Read the whole repository with the agent that built it
records.description: Agent-built code works but stops feeling like yours. Co-Review opens the whole repository as a review: comment on a line, file or folder, ask why, and the agent answers from the code. Also reviews diffs, PRs and designs. Free, open source, no telemetry.

records.name: Searchunk
records.tagline: Find your photos and videos by describing them
records.description: Searchunk makes your image and video archive searchable with AI, wherever it lives: Amazon S3, Google Cloud, Azure, OVHcloud, Backblaze and 15+ other storage services, or folders on your computer. Describe what you're looking for in English or Turkish; the best frames come first, whatever the file is called. It reads text in images and searches videos scene by scene. Originals stay in your storage and every AI model runs on our own servers.

records.name: Willder
records.tagline: The context layer that syncs your apps, agents and teams
records.description: A context layer that syncs your apps, agents and teams. Each agent gets its own scoped, revocable token; what one agent writes, the others read on their next call; connectors bring your apps in under the same rules (measured on GitHub so far). The engine is MIT and self-hostable.

records.name: ClearWeek 2027
records.tagline: A hyperlinked digital planner for your year
records.description: Plan your 2027 in one place with 53 weekly planning and review spreads, 12 monthly calendars and habit trackers, yearly and quarterly goals, progress reviews, notes, and hyperlinked navigation. A 172-page landscape PDF for GoodNotes, Notability, and other PDF annotation apps.

records.name: SumHatch Math
records.tagline: Free graphing calculator. No account required.
records.description: Plot functions, change parameters with sliders, and inspect a table of values. SumHatch Math is a free browser-based graphing calculator with shareable graph links, PNG exports, and worked examples. Use radians or degrees and explore how equations change a graph. No account required.

records.name: Piercing Gauge Converter
records.tagline: Convert piercing gauges to mm and inches in one click
records.description: A free Chrome extension for piercers, studios and jewelry suppliers, made by Desire Surgical (desiresurgical.com). Convert gauges (20G to 00G) to mm and inches, find the closest gauge for any mm size, convert bar lengths and ring sizes, and check a full gauge chart. Works offline, no sign-up, no data collected.

records.name: PatentRef
records.tagline: US patent claims as a tree, through a free API
records.description: A free US patent API in the PatentsView format for grants since 1976, plus a claim tree for every patent: claims split into their parts, each reference linked to its earlier mention, every part with offsets into the text. Deterministic code, no model.

records.name: Almanzor
records.tagline: Ask AI + MCP server for your docs, with cited answers
records.description: Paste your docs URL and get an assistant that answers from your pages, cites its source and says when it doesn't know. Add it with one script tag, share a link, or let coding agents search your docs through a hosted MCP server.

records.name: HitPay Agentic Discovery
records.tagline: Make your store findable and buyable by AI agents
records.description: Agentic Discovery lets any AI assistant find and recommend what you sell on HitPay: product and price and a Checkout with HitPay button in chat. Each store gets its own MCP server. Free to switch on; standard fees when you sell.

records.name: XTen
records.tagline: A song's guitar tone as knob values on your own gear
records.description: Pick a song and the gear you own, and XTen tells you how far to turn each knob. Upload an audio file or paste a YouTube link, choose your amps, pedals, multi-effects, guitar and pickup, listen to the separated guitar tracks, and get values written in each device's real knob names and scale. Every value carries a trust grade: amp gain band and delay time are reliable, and the rest are starting points to tune by ear. Supports 119 amps, 336 pedals, 49 multi-effects families and 175 guitars.

records.name: Apple Gift Card Giveaway: Win $2,500
records.tagline: Free Apple Gift Card Giveaway: Win $2,500, 7 Countries
records.description: Open to Argentina, Indonesia, Turkey, Vietnam, the USA, Canada and Germany. Enter free for a chance to win $2,500. Not affiliated with Apple.

records.name: PulseCRM AI
records.tagline: AI Customer Intelligence & Predictive Churn Analytics
records.description: Turnkey AI CRM platform that scores account churn risk in real-time, automates retention workflows, and pinpoints high-value accounts for sales teams.

records.name: LumoAuth
records.tagline: Passwordless sign-in and AI agent approvals from your phone
records.description: LumoAuth is the login and access-control service for your product. Users sign in without passwords: passkeys, magic links, or a push to the Lumo Authenticator app (iOS & Android) where they tap the matching number and confirm with Face ID. The same app lets people approve or deny what your AI agents want to do, like a payment, before it happens. Also: enterprise SSO, SAML, SCIM and roles, all on open standards. SDKs in 6 languages. Free for 10K monthly users.
